name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.decreasingEigenvalues_compress_le
statement:
theorem decreasingEigenvalues_compress_le
    (hInterlace : Interlacing 𝕜) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜} (hV : MatrixIsometry V)
    (i : Fin k) :
    decreasingEigenvalues (compress_isHermitian hA V) i ≤
      decreasingEigenvalues hA (Fin.castLE hkn i)
proof:
:=
  (hInterlace n k hkn A V hA hV i).1

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.decreasingEigenvalues_compress_inv_le
statement:
theorem decreasingEigenvalues_compress_inv_le
    (hInterlace : Interlacing 𝕜) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    {B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hB : B.PosDef)
    {V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜} (hV : MatrixIsometry V)
    (i : Fin k) :
    decreasingEigenvalues (compress_isHermitian hB.inv.isHermitian V) i ≤
      decreasingEigenvalues hB.inv.isHermitian (Fin.castLE hkn i)
proof:
:=
  decreasingEigenvalues_compress_le hInterlace hkn hB.inv.isHermitian hV i

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.increasingEigenvalues_le_shorted
statement:
theorem increasingEigenvalues_le_shorted
    (hInterlace : Interlacing 𝕜) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    {B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hB : B.PosDef)
    {V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜} (hV : MatrixIsometry V)
    (i : Fin k) :
    increasingEigenvalues (shorted_posDef hV hB).isHermitian i ≥
      increasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian (Fin.castLE hkn i)
proof:
:= by
  let H : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) 𝕜 := compress V B⁻¹
  have hH : H.PosDef := compress_posDef hV hB.inv
  have hinterlace :
      decreasingEigenvalues hH.isHermitian i ≤
        decreasingEigenvalues hB.inv.isHermitian (Fin.castLE hkn i) := by
    simpa [H] using decreasingEigenvalues_compress_inv_le
      hInterlace hkn hB hV i
  have hright :
      decreasingEigenvalues hB.inv.isHermitian (Fin.castLE hkn i) =
        (decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian (Fin.castLE hkn i).rev)⁻¹ :=
    Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_inv hB (Fin.castLE hkn i)
  have hposH : 0 < decreasingEigenvalues hH.isHermitian i :=
    Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hH i
  have hinv :
      decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian (Fin.castLE hkn i).rev ≤
        (decreasingEigenvalues hH.isHermitian i)⁻¹ := by
    have := inv_anti₀ hposH (hright ▸ hinterlace)
    simpa using this
  have hleft :
      increasingEigenvalues (shorted_posDef hV hB).isHermitian i =
        (decreasingEigenvalues hH.isHermitian i)⁻¹ := by
    simpa [shorted, H, increasingEigenvalues, Function.comp_def] using
      Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_inv hH i.rev
  calc
    increasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian (Fin.castLE hkn i) =
        decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian (Fin.castLE hkn i).rev := rfl
    _ ≤ (decreasingEigenvalues hH.isHermitian i)⁻¹ := hinv
    _ = increasingEigenvalues (shorted_posDef hV hB).isHermitian i := hleft.symm

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.decreasingEigenvectorUnitary_isometry
statement:
theorem decreasingEigenvectorUnitary_isometry
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (decreasingEigenvectorUnitary hA).conjTranspose *
        decreasingEigenvectorUnitary hA = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hu := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  ext i j
  have hij := congrArg
    (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 ↦
      M (decreasingIndexEquiv n i) (decreasingIndexEquiv n j)) hu
  simpa [decreasingEigenvectorUnitary, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] using hij

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.mul_decreasingEigenvectorUnitary

    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    A * decreasingEigenvectorUnitary hA =
      decreasingEigenvectorUnitary hA *
        Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ decreasingEigenvalues hA)
proof:
:= by
  ext p i
  have h := congrFun
    (hA.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis (decreasingIndexEquiv n i)) p
  rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  simpa [decreasingEigenvectorUnitary, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, eigenvalues_decreasingIndexEquiv,
    RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul, mul_comm] using h

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.decreasingEigenvalues_eq_of_diagonalization
statement:
theorem decreasingEigenvalues_eq_of_diagonalization
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) (f : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hf : Antitone f) (hU : U.conjTranspose * U = 1)
    (hrel : A * U = U * Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ f)) :
    decreasingEigenvalues hA = f
proof:
:= by
  have hUU : U * U.conjTranspose = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hU
  have hspec : A = U * Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ f) * U.conjTranspose := by
    calc
      A = A * (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) := (Matrix.mul_one A).symm
      _ = A * (U * U.conjTranspose) := by rw [hUU]
      _ = (A * U) * U.conjTranspose := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (U * Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ f)) * U.conjTranspose := by rw [hrel]
  have hchar : A.charpoly =
      ∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ((RCLike.ofReal ∘ f) i)) := by
    rw [hspec, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hU, Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.charpoly_diagonal]
  have hroots :
      A.charpoly.roots =
        Multiset.map (RCLike.ofReal ∘ f) Finset.univ.val := by
    rw [hchar, Polynomial.roots_prod]
    · simp
    · simp [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff, Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero]
  have hsort :
      (A.charpoly.roots.map RCLike.re).sort (· ≥ ·) = List.ofFn f := by
    simp_rw [hroots, Fin.univ_val_map, Multiset.map_coe, List.map_ofFn,
      Function.comp_def, RCLike.ofReal_re, Multiset.coe_sort]
    apply List.mergeSort_of_pairwise
    simp_rw [decide_eq_true_eq, ← List.sortedGE_iff_pairwise]
    exact hf.sortedGE_ofFn
  have hspectrum := hA.sort_roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues₀
  have hbase :
      (fun i : Fin n ↦ hA.eigenvalues₀
        (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin n).symm i)) = f := by
    simpa using hspectrum.symm.trans hsort
  funext i
  change hA.eigenvalues₀
    (finCongr (Fintype.card_fin n).symm i) = f i
  rw [show finCongr (Fintype.card_fin n).symm i =
    Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin n).symm i by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl]
  exact congrFun hbase i

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.reverseColumns_isometry
statement:
theorem reverseColumns_isometry
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hU : U.conjTranspose * U = 1) :
    (reverseColumns U).conjTranspose * reverseColumns U = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have hij := congrArg
    (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 ↦ M i.rev j.rev) hU
  simpa [reverseColumns, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] using hij

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_inv
statement:
theorem Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_inv
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (i : Fin n) :
    decreasingEigenvalues hA.inv.isHermitian i =
      (decreasingEigenvalues hA.isHermitian i.rev)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let U := decreasingEigenvectorUnitary hA.isHermitian
  let D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 :=
    Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ decreasingEigenvalues hA.isHermitian)
  let E : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 :=
    Matrix.diagonal (fun j ↦ RCLike.ofReal
      ((decreasingEigenvalues hA.isHermitian j)⁻¹))
  let Urev := reverseColumns U
  let f : Fin n → ℝ := fun j ↦
    (decreasingEigenvalues hA.isHermitian j.rev)⁻¹
  have hU : U.conjTranspose * U = 1 :=
    decreasingEigenvectorUnitary_isometry hA.isHermitian
  have hrel : A * U = U * D :=
    mul_decreasingEigenvectorUnitary hA.isHermitian
  have hDE : D * E = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, ← Matrix.diagonal_one]
    congr 1
    funext j
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, RCLike.ofReal_inv]
    exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (RCLike.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr
      (Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hA j).ne')
  letI : Invertible A := hA.isUnit.invertible
  have hInvRel : A⁻¹ * U = U * E := by
    apply (Matrix.inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul_of_invertible A U (U * E)).2
    calc
      U = U * (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) := (Matrix.mul_one U).symm
      _ = U * (D * E) := by rw [hDE]
      _ = (U * D) * E := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (A * U) * E := by rw [hrel]
      _ = A * (U * E) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hInvRelRev :
      A⁻¹ * Urev = Urev * Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ f) := by
    ext p j
    have hj := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 ↦ M p j.rev) hInvRel
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal] at hj
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    change (A⁻¹ * U) p j.rev =
      U p j.rev * RCLike.ofReal
        ((decreasingEigenvalues hA.isHermitian j.rev)⁻¹)
    simpa [E, Function.comp_def] using hj
  have hf : Antitone f := by
    intro p q hpq
    apply inv_anti₀
    · exact Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hA p.rev
    · exact decreasingEigenvalues_antitone hA.isHermitian
        (Fin.rev_le_rev.mpr hpq)
  have hUrev : Urev.conjTranspose * Urev = 1 :=
    reverseColumns_isometry hU
  have hordered := decreasingEigenvalues_eq_of_diagonalization
    hA.inv.isHermitian Urev f hf hUrev hInvRelRev
  exact congrFun hordered i

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.sum_comp_decreasingEigenvalues_eq_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem sum_comp_decreasingEigenvalues_eq_eigenvalues
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] (f : ℝ → R) :
    (∑ i, f (decreasingEigenvalues hA i)) =
      ∑ i, f (hA.eigenvalues i)
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin n)) ≃ Fin n :=
    Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin (Fintype.card (Fin n)))
  calc
    (∑ i, f (decreasingEigenvalues hA i)) =
        ∑ i, f (hA.eigenvalues₀ i) :=
      (finCongr (Fintype.card_fin n).symm).sum_comp
        (f ∘ hA.eigenvalues₀)
    _ = ∑ i, f (hA.eigenvalues i) := by
      exact (e.symm.sum_comp (f ∘ hA.eigenvalues₀)).symm

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.prod_comp_decreasingEigenvalues_eq_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem prod_comp_decreasingEigenvalues_eq_eigenvalues
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {R : Type*} [CommMonoid R] (f : ℝ → R) :
    (∏ i, f (decreasingEigenvalues hA i)) =
      ∏ i, f (hA.eigenvalues i)
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin n)) ≃ Fin n :=
    Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin (Fintype.card (Fin n)))
  calc
    (∏ i, f (decreasingEigenvalues hA i)) =
        ∏ i, f (hA.eigenvalues₀ i) :=
      (finCongr (Fintype.card_fin n).symm).prod_comp
        (f ∘ hA.eigenvalues₀)
    _ = ∏ i, f (hA.eigenvalues i) := by
      exact (e.symm.prod_comp (f ∘ hA.eigenvalues₀)).symm

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.MatrixIsometry.mulVec_injective

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.compress_posDef

theorem compress_posDef [Finite k]
    {V : Matrix n k 𝕜} (hV : MatrixIsometry V)
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) : (compress V A).PosDef

:= by
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite k

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.compress_mono
proof:
:= by
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite k
  classical
  change (compress V B - compress V A).PosSemidef
  have hdiff : (B - A).PosSemidef := hAB
  have hcongr := hdiff.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same V
  have heq : V.conjTranspose * (B - A) * V =
      compress V B - compress V A := by
    ext i j

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.shorted_posDef

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.bottomEigenvectorIsometry_isometry
statement:
theorem bottomEigenvectorIsometry_isometry
    {A : Matrix (Fin b) (Fin b) 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    MatrixIsometry (bottomEigenvectorIsometry hA hab)
proof:
:= by
  have hU := decreasingEigenvectorUnitary_isometry hA.isHermitian
  ext i j
  have hij := congrArg
    (fun M : Matrix (Fin b) (Fin b) 𝕜 ↦
      M (bottomFinEmbedding hab i) (bottomFinEmbedding hab j)) hU
  simpa [MatrixIsometry, bottomEigenvectorIsometry, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.one_apply] using hij

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.mul_bottomEigenvectorIsometry
statement:
theorem mul_bottomEigenvectorIsometry
    {A : Matrix (Fin b) (Fin b) 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    A * bottomEigenvectorIsometry hA hab =
      bottomEigenvectorIsometry hA hab * Matrix.diagonal
        (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal
          (decreasingEigenvalues hA.isHermitian (bottomFinEmbedding hab i)))
proof:
:= by
  let U := decreasingEigenvectorUnitary hA.isHermitian
  have hU := mul_decreasingEigenvectorUnitary hA.isHermitian
  ext p i
  have hi := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin b) (Fin b) 𝕜 ↦
    M p (bottomFinEmbedding hab i)) hU
  rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal] at hi
  rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  simpa [bottomEigenvectorIsometry, U, Matrix.mul_apply] using hi

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.compress_bottom_eq_diagonal
statement:
private theorem compress_bottom_eq_diagonal
    {A : Matrix (Fin b) (Fin b) 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    compress (bottomEigenvectorIsometry hA hab) A =
      Matrix.diagonal
        (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal
          (decreasingEigenvalues hA.isHermitian (bottomFinEmbedding hab i)))
proof:
:= by
  let V := bottomEigenvectorIsometry hA hab
  let D : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin a) 𝕜 := Matrix.diagonal
    (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal
      (decreasingEigenvalues hA.isHermitian (bottomFinEmbedding hab i)))
  have hV : MatrixIsometry V := bottomEigenvectorIsometry_isometry hA hab
  have hrel : A * V = V * D := mul_bottomEigenvectorIsometry hA hab
  calc
    compress V A = V.conjTranspose * (A * V) := by
      simp [compress, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = V.conjTranspose * (V * D) := by rw [hrel]
    _ = (V.conjTranspose * V) * D := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = D := by rw [hV, Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = Matrix.diagonal
        (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal
          (decreasingEigenvalues hA.isHermitian (bottomFinEmbedding hab i))) := rfl

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.shorted_bottom_eq_diagonal
statement:
private theorem shorted_bottom_eq_diagonal
    {A : Matrix (Fin b) (Fin b) 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    shorted (bottomEigenvectorIsometry hA hab) A =
      Matrix.diagonal
        (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal
          (decreasingEigenvalues hA.isHermitian (bottomFinEmbedding hab i)))
proof:
:= by
  let V := bottomEigenvectorIsometry hA hab
  let D : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin a) 𝕜 := Matrix.diagonal
    (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal
      (decreasingEigenvalues hA.isHermitian (bottomFinEmbedding hab i)))
  have hV : MatrixIsometry V := bottomEigenvectorIsometry_isometry hA hab
  have hrel : A * V = V * D := mul_bottomEigenvectorIsometry hA hab
  have hD : D.PosDef := by
    apply Matrix.PosDef.diagonal
    intro i
    simpa [D] using Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hA
      (bottomFinEmbedding hab i)
  letI : Invertible A := hA.isUnit.invertible
  letI : Invertible D := hD.isUnit.invertible
  have hInvRel : A⁻¹ * V = V * D⁻¹ := by
    apply (Matrix.inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul_of_invertible A V (V * D⁻¹)).2
    calc
      V = V * (1 : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin a) 𝕜) := (Matrix.mul_one V).symm
      _ = V * (D * D⁻¹) := by rw [Matrix.mul_inv_of_invertible]
      _ = (V * D) * D⁻¹ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (A * V) * D⁻¹ := by rw [hrel]
      _ = A * (V * D⁻¹) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hcompressInv : compress V A⁻¹ = D⁻¹ := by
    calc
      compress V A⁻¹ = V.conjTranspose * (A⁻¹ * V) := by
        simp [compress, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = V.conjTranspose * (V * D⁻¹) := by rw [hInvRel]
      _ = (V.conjTranspose * V) * D⁻¹ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = D⁻¹ := by rw [hV, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [shorted, hcompressInv, Matrix.inv_inv_of_invertible]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.shorted_bottomEigenvectors
statement:
theorem shorted_bottomEigenvectors
    {A : Matrix (Fin b) (Fin b) 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    shorted (bottomEigenvectorIsometry hA hab) A =
        compress (bottomEigenvectorIsometry hA hab) A ∧
      RCLike.re (shorted (bottomEigenvectorIsometry hA hab) A).det =
        ∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hA.isHermitian
          (bottomFinEmbedding hab i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [shorted_bottom_eq_diagonal hA hab,
      compress_bottom_eq_diagonal hA hab]
  · rw [shorted_bottom_eq_diagonal hA hab, Matrix.det_diagonal]
    rw [← RCLike.ofReal_prod]
    exact RCLike.ofReal_re _

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.shorted_variational
statement:
theorem shorted_variational
    {V : Matrix n k ℂ} (hV : MatrixIsometry V)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    (A - V * shorted V A * V.conjTranspose).PosSemidef ∧
      ∀ {C : Matrix k k ℂ}, C.PosDef →
        (A - V * C * V.conjTranspose).PosSemidef → C ≤ shorted V A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · let H : Matrix k k ℂ := compress V A⁻¹
    have hH : H.PosDef := compress_posDef hV hA.inv
    letI : Invertible A := hA.isUnit.invertible
    letI : Invertible H := hH.isUnit.invertible
    have hzero : (H - V.conjTranspose * A⁻¹ * V).PosSemidef := by
      have heq : H - V.conjTranspose * A⁻¹ * V = 0 := by
        simp [H, compress]
      rw [heq]
      exact Matrix.PosSemidef.zero
    have hblock : (Matrix.fromBlocks A V V.conjTranspose H).PosSemidef :=
      (Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁ V H hA).2 hzero
    have hout := (Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₂₂ A V hH).1 hblock
    simpa [shorted, H] using hout
  · intro C hC hres
    let H : Matrix k k ℂ := compress V A⁻¹
    have hH : H.PosDef := compress_posDef hV hA.inv
    letI : Invertible A := hA.isUnit.invertible
    letI : Invertible C := hC.isUnit.invertible
    letI : Invertible C⁻¹ := hC.inv.isUnit.invertible
    have hblock :
        (Matrix.fromBlocks A V V.conjTranspose C⁻¹).PosSemidef := by
      apply (Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₂₂ A V hC.inv).2
      simpa using hres
    have hschur :
        (C⁻¹ - V.conjTranspose * A⁻¹ * V).PosSemidef :=
      (Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁ V C⁻¹ hA).1 hblock
    have hHCinv : H ≤ C⁻¹ := by
      change (C⁻¹ - H).PosSemidef
      simpa [H, compress] using hschur
    have hinv :=
      CStarAlgebra.ringInverse_le_ringInverse hHCinv hH.isStrictlyPositive
    simpa [shorted, H, Ring.inverse_of_isUnit hH.isUnit,
      Ring.inverse_of_isUnit hC.inv.isUnit] using hinv

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.weightedGeometricMean_shorted_le
statement:
theorem weightedGeometricMean_shorted_le
    (hAndo : Ando ℂ n k)
    {V : Matrix n k ℂ} (hV : MatrixIsometry V)
    {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef)
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    weightedGeometricMean (shorted V A) (shorted V B) t ≤
      shorted V (weightedGeometricMean A B t)
proof:
:= by
  let HA : Matrix k k ℂ := compress V A⁻¹
  let HB : Matrix k k ℂ := compress V B⁻¹
  let L : Matrix k k ℂ :=
    compress V (weightedGeometricMean A⁻¹ B⁻¹ t)
  let R : Matrix k k ℂ := weightedGeometricMean HA HB t
  have hHA : HA.PosDef := compress_posDef hV hA.inv
  have hHB : HB.PosDef := compress_posDef hV hB.inv
  have hL : L.PosDef :=
    compress_posDef hV (weightedGeometricMean_posDef hA.inv hB.inv t)
  have hR : R.PosDef := weightedGeometricMean_posDef hHA hHB t
  have hLR : L ≤ R := by
    simpa [L, R, HA, HB] using hAndo V A⁻¹ B⁻¹ t hV hA.inv hB.inv ht0 ht1
  letI : Invertible L := hL.isUnit.invertible
  letI : Invertible R := hR.isUnit.invertible
  have hinv : R⁻¹ ≤ L⁻¹ := by
    have h := CStarAlgebra.ringInverse_le_ringInverse hLR hL.isStrictlyPositive
    simpa [Ring.inverse_of_isUnit hR.isUnit,
      Ring.inverse_of_isUnit hL.isUnit] using h
  calc
    weightedGeometricMean (shorted V A) (shorted V B) t =
        weightedGeometricMean HA⁻¹ HB⁻¹ t := by rfl
    _ = R⁻¹ := by
      rw [weightedGeometricMean_inv hHA hHB t]
    _ ≤ L⁻¹ := hinv
    _ = shorted V (weightedGeometricMean A B t) := by
      rw [shorted, weightedGeometricMean_inv hA hB t]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.shorted_superadditive
statement:
theorem shorted_superadditive
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    {V : Matrix n k ℂ} (hV : MatrixIsometry V)
    (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j)
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ j, (A j).PosDef) :
    (∑ j, w j • shorted V (A j)) ≤
      shorted V (∑ j, w j • A j)
proof:
:= by
  let Asum : Matrix n n ℂ := ∑ j, w j • A j
  let Csum : Matrix k k ℂ := ∑ j, w j • shorted V (A j)
  have hAsum : Asum.PosDef := by
    apply Matrix.posDef_sum Finset.univ_nonempty
    intro j _
    exact (hA j).smul (hw j)
  have hCsum : Csum.PosDef := by
    apply Matrix.posDef_sum Finset.univ_nonempty
    intro j _
    exact (shorted_posDef hV (hA j)).smul (hw j)
  have hresEach (j : ι) :
      (w j • (A j - V * shorted V (A j) * V.conjTranspose)).PosSemidef :=
    (shorted_variational hV (hA j)).1.smul (hw j).le
  have hresSum :
      (∑ j, w j •
        (A j - V * shorted V (A j) * V.conjTranspose)).PosSemidef := by
    simpa using Matrix.posSemidef_sum Finset.univ
      (fun j _ ↦ hresEach j)
  have heq :
      Asum - V * Csum * V.conjTranspose =
        ∑ j, w j •
          (A j - V * shorted V (A j) * V.conjTranspose) := by
    dsimp [Asum, Csum]
    rw [Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
    exact (smul_sub (w j) (A j)
      (V * shorted V (A j) * V.conjTranspose)).symm
  apply (shorted_variational hV hAsum).2 hCsum
  rw [heq]
  exact hresSum

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.inv_weakLogMajorized_of_lowerProductDominates
statement:
theorem inv_weakLogMajorized_of_lowerProductDominates
    {n : ℕ} {y q : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hy : ∀ i, 0 < y i) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i)
    (hy_mono : Monotone y) (hq_mono : Monotone q)
    (h : LowerProductDominates y q) :
    WeakLogMajorized (fun i ↦ (y i)⁻¹) (fun i ↦ (q i)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨fun i ↦ inv_pos.mpr (hy i), ?_⟩,
    ⟨fun i ↦ inv_pos.mpr (hq i), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    exact (inv_le_inv₀ (hy j) (hy i)).2 (hy_mono hij)
  · intro i j hij
    exact (inv_le_inv₀ (hq j) (hq i)).2 (hq_mono hij)
  · intro k hk0 hk
    rw [prefixProd_inv, prefixProd_inv]
    exact (inv_le_inv₀ (prefixProd_pos hy k hk) (prefixProd_pos hq k hk)).2
      (h k hk0 hk)

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.product_le_one_of_sum_le_card
statement:
theorem product_le_one_of_sum_le_card
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {z : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hz : ∀ i, 0 ≤ z i) (hsum : ∑ i, z i ≤ (n : ℝ)) :
    ∏ i, z i ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
  have hgm := Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))
    (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) z (by simp) (by simpa using hn) (by simpa using hz)
  have hroot : (∏ i, z i) ^ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      (∏ i, z i) ^ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (∑ i, z i) / (n : ℝ) := by simpa using hgm
      _ ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hn).2 hsum
  have hprod : 0 ≤ ∏ i, z i := Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hz i
  simpa using (Real.rpow_inv_le_iff_of_pos hprod zero_le_one hn).1 hroot

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.product_le_product_of_sum_rpow_div_le_card
statement:
theorem product_le_product_of_sum_rpow_div_le_card
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {q y : Fin n → ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (hy : ∀ i, 0 < y i) (ht : 0 < t)
    (htrace : ∑ i, (q i / y i) ^ t ≤ (n : ℝ)) :
    ∏ i, q i ≤ ∏ i, y i
proof:
:= by
  let z : Fin n → ℝ := fun i ↦ (q i / y i) ^ t
  have hz : ∀ i, 0 ≤ z i := fun i ↦ Real.rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg (hq i).le (hy i).le) _
  have hzprod : ∏ i, z i ≤ 1 :=
    product_le_one_of_sum_le_card hz (by simpa [z] using htrace)
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ ∏ i, q i := (Finset.prod_pos fun i _ ↦ hq i).le
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ ∏ i, y i := (Finset.prod_pos fun i _ ↦ hy i).le
  have hypos : 0 < ∏ i, y i := Finset.prod_pos fun i _ ↦ hy i
  have hratio_nonneg : 0 ≤ (∏ i, q i) / ∏ i, y i := div_nonneg hq0 hy0
  have hratio_rpow : ((∏ i, q i) / ∏ i, y i) ^ t ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      ((∏ i, q i) / ∏ i, y i) ^ t = (∏ i, q i / y i) ^ t := by
        rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib]
      _ = ∏ i, (q i / y i) ^ t :=
        (Real.finsetProd_rpow Finset.univ (fun i ↦ q i / y i)
          (fun i _ ↦ div_nonneg (hq i).le (hy i).le) t).symm
      _ = ∏ i, z i := rfl
      _ ≤ 1 := hzprod
  have hratio : (∏ i, q i) / ∏ i, y i ≤ 1 := by
    have := (Real.rpow_le_rpow_iff hratio_nonneg zero_le_one ht).1
      (by simpa using hratio_rpow)
    simpa using this
  exact (div_le_one hypos).1 hratio

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.WeakLogMajorized.sum_rpow_le_sum_rpow
statement:
theorem WeakLogMajorized.sum_rpow_le_sum_rpow
    {n : ℕ} {x y : Fin n → ℝ} (h : WeakLogMajorized x y)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    (∑ i, (x i) ^ q) ≤ ∑ i, (y i) ^ q
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨⟨hx0, hx⟩, ⟨hy0, hy⟩, hprod⟩
  have hlogx : Antitone (fun i ↦ Real.log (x i)) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact Real.strictMonoOn_log.monotoneOn (by simpa using hx0 j)
      (by simpa using hx0 i) (hx hij)
  have hlogy : Antitone (fun i ↦ Real.log (y i)) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact Real.strictMonoOn_log.monotoneOn (by simpa using hy0 j)
      (by simpa using hy0 i) (hy hij)
  have hprefix : ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n),
      (∑ i : Fin k, Real.log (x (Fin.castLE hk i))) ≤
        ∑ i : Fin k, Real.log (y (Fin.castLE hk i)) := by
    intro k hk
    by_cases hk0 : k = 0
    · subst k
      simp
    have hkpos : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk0
    have hp := hprod k hkpos hk
    change (∏ i : Fin k, x (Fin.castLE hk i)) ≤
      ∏ i : Fin k, y (Fin.castLE hk i) at hp
    have hxprod : 0 < ∏ i : Fin k, x (Fin.castLE hk i) :=
      Finset.prod_pos fun i _ ↦ hx0 _
    have hyprod : 0 < ∏ i : Fin k, y (Fin.castLE hk i) :=
      Finset.prod_pos fun i _ ↦ hy0 _
    rw [← Real.log_prod (fun i _ ↦ (hx0 _).ne'),
      ← Real.log_prod (fun i _ ↦ (hy0 _).ne')]
    exact Real.strictMonoOn_log.monotoneOn (by simpa using hxprod)
      (by simpa using hyprod) hp
  have hexp := sum_exp_le_sum_exp_of_fin_prefix hlogx hlogy hprefix hq
  calc
    (∑ i, (x i) ^ q) = ∑ i, Real.exp (q * Real.log (x i)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (hx0 i)]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ ∑ i, Real.exp (q * Real.log (y i)) := hexp
    _ = ∑ i, (y i) ^ q := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (hy0 i)]
      congr 1
      ring

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.weighted_rpow_neg_le
statement:
private theorem weighted_rpow_neg_le
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {a z : Fin n → ℝ} {s : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (hasum : ∑ i, a i = 1)
    (hz : ∀ i, 0 < z i) (hs : s < 0) :
    (∑ i, a i * z i) ^ s ≤ ∑ i, a i * (z i) ^ s
proof:
:= by
  have hgm := Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) a z
    (by simpa using ha) (by simpa using hasum)
    (by simpa using fun i ↦ (hz i).le)
  have hprodpos : 0 < ∏ i, (z i) ^ (a i) :=
    Finset.prod_pos fun i _ ↦ Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hz i) _
  have hsumpos : 0 < ∑ i, a i * z i := lt_of_lt_of_le hprodpos hgm
  have hreverse :
      (∑ i, a i * z i) ^ s ≤ (∏ i, (z i) ^ (a i)) ^ s :=
    (Real.rpow_le_rpow_iff_of_neg hsumpos hprodpos hs).2 hgm
  have hreorder :
      (∏ i, (z i) ^ (a i)) ^ s = ∏ i, ((z i) ^ s) ^ (a i) := by
    rw [← Real.finsetProd_rpow Finset.univ (fun i ↦ (z i) ^ (a i))
      (fun i _ ↦ Real.rpow_nonneg (hz i).le _) s]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul (hz i).le, ← Real.rpow_mul (hz i).le]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hgmPower := Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) a (fun i ↦ (z i) ^ s)
    (by simpa using ha) (by simpa using hasum)
    (by simpa using fun i ↦ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hz i) s).le)
  calc
    (∑ i, a i * z i) ^ s ≤ (∏ i, (z i) ^ (a i)) ^ s := hreverse
    _ = ∏ i, ((z i) ^ s) ^ (a i) := hreorder
    _ ≤ ∑ i, a i * (z i) ^ s := by simpa using hgmPower

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.sum_powerCoordinate_le
statement:
theorem sum_powerCoordinate_le
    {n m : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero m]
    {w : Fin m → ℝ} {x : Fin n → Fin m → ℝ} {s : ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j)
    (hx : ∀ i j, 0 < x i j) (hs : s < 0) :
    (∑ i, powerCoordinate w (x i) s) ≤
      powerCoordinate w (fun j ↦ ∑ i, x i j) s
proof:
:= by
  let u : Fin n → ℝ := fun i ↦ powerCoordinate w (x i) s
  let U : ℝ := ∑ i, u i
  let a : Fin n → ℝ := fun i ↦ u i / U
  have hu : ∀ i, 0 < u i := fun i ↦ powerCoordinate_pos hw (hx i)
  have hU : 0 < U := Finset.sum_pos
    (fun i _ ↦ hu i) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i := fun i ↦ div_nonneg (hu i).le hU.le
  have hasum : ∑ i, a i = 1 := by
    rw [show (∑ i, a i) = U / U by simp [a, U, Finset.sum_div]]
    exact div_self hU.ne'
  have hjensen : ∀ j,
      (∑ i, a i * (x i j / u i)) ^ s ≤
        ∑ i, a i * (x i j / u i) ^ s := by
    intro j
    exact weighted_rpow_neg_le ha hasum
      (fun i ↦ div_pos (hx i j) (hu i)) hs
  have hweighted := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j (_hj : j ∈ Finset.univ) ↦
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hjensen j) (hw j).le
  have hleft :
      (∑ j, w j * (∑ i, a i * (x i j / u i)) ^ s) =
        ∑ j, w j * ((∑ i, x i j) / U) ^ s := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    congr 1
    congr 1
    calc
      (∑ i, a i * (x i j / u i)) = ∑ i, x i j / U := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        simp only [a]
        field_simp [hU.ne', (hu i).ne']
      _ = (∑ i, x i j) / U := by rw [Finset.sum_div]
  have hright :
      (∑ j, w j * ∑ i, a i * (x i j / u i) ^ s) = 1 := by
    calc
      (∑ j, w j * ∑ i, a i * (x i j / u i) ^ s) =
          ∑ j, ∑ i, w j * (a i * (x i j / u i) ^ s) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, w j * (a i * (x i j / u i) ^ s) :=
        Finset.sum_comm
      _ = ∑ i, a i * ∑ j, w j * (x i j / u i) ^ s := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        ring
      _ = ∑ i, a i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [← powerCoordinate_div_rpow_of_ne hw (hx i) (hu i) hs.ne]
        change a i * (u i / u i) ^ s = a i
        rw [div_self (hu i).ne']
        simp
      _ = 1 := hasum
  rw [hleft, hright] at hweighted
  let v : ℝ := powerCoordinate w (fun j ↦ ∑ i, x i j) s
  have hxsum : ∀ j, 0 < ∑ i, x i j := fun j ↦
    Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ ↦ hx i j) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hv : 0 < v := powerCoordinate_pos hw hxsum
  have hratioPower : (v / U) ^ s ≤ 1 := by
    rw [powerCoordinate_div_rpow_of_ne hw hxsum hU hs.ne]
    exact hweighted
  have honeRatio : 1 ≤ v / U :=
    (Real.rpow_le_rpow_iff_of_neg (div_pos hv hU) zero_lt_one hs).1
      (by simpa using hratioPower)
  exact (one_le_div hU).1 honeRatio

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.powerCoordinate_rpow_scale
statement:
private theorem powerCoordinate_rpow_scale
    {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {w x : Fin m → ℝ} {r q : ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 < x j)
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    (powerCoordinate w x r) ^ q =
      powerCoordinate w (fun j ↦ (x j) ^ q) (r / q)
proof:
:= by
  let S : ℝ := ∑ j, w j * (x j) ^ r
  have hS : 0 < S := Finset.sum_pos
    (fun j _ ↦ mul_pos (hw j) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hx j) r))
    Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hinner :
      (∑ j, w j * ((x j) ^ q) ^ (r / q)) = S := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    congr 1
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul (hx j).le]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  unfold powerCoordinate
  rw [hinner]
  change (S ^ r⁻¹) ^ q = S ^ (r / q)⁻¹
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul hS.le]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.powerCoordinate_root_scale
statement:

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.negativePowerMean_schattenQ_le_of_boundaries
statement:
theorem negativePowerMean_schattenQ_le_of_boundaries
    {n m : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero m]
    (hLP : FixedPoint ℂ)
    (hLidskii : Lidskii ℂ)
    (hAndo : ∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k], Ando ℂ (Fin n) (Fin k))
    (hInterlace : Interlacing ℂ)
    (ω : ProbabilityWeights (Fin m))
    (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (r q : ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ j, (A j).PosDef) (hr1 : -1 ≤ r) (hr0 : r < 0)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    schattenQ (hLP.negativePowerMean_posDef ω A r hA hr1 hr0) q ≤
      powerCoordinate ω.value (fun j ↦ schattenQ (hA j) q) r
proof:
:= by
  let P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ :=
    hLP.negativePowerMean ω A r hA hr1 hr0
  have hP : P.PosDef := by
    simpa [P] using hLP.negativePowerMean_posDef ω A r hA hr1 hr0
  let a : Fin n → Fin m → ℝ := fun i j ↦
    decreasingEigenvalues (hA j).isHermitian i
  let c : Fin n → ℝ := fun i ↦ powerCoordinate ω.value (a i) r
  have ha : ∀ i j, 0 < a i j := fun i j ↦
    Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos (hA j) i
  have hc : ∀ i, 0 < c i := fun i ↦ powerCoordinate_pos ω.positive (ha i)
  have hlog : WeakLogMajorized
      (decreasingEigenvalues hP.isHermitian) c := by
    simpa [P, a, c] using
      negativePowerMean_weakLogMajorized_of_boundaries
        hLP hLidskii hAndo hInterlace ω A r hA hr1 hr0
  have hmoment :
      (∑ i, (decreasingEigenvalues hP.isHermitian i) ^ q) ≤
        ∑ i, (c i) ^ q :=
    hlog.sum_rpow_le_sum_rpow hq
  have hrootMoment :
      (∑ i, (decreasingEigenvalues hP.isHermitian i) ^ q) ^ q⁻¹ ≤
        (∑ i, (c i) ^ q) ^ q⁻¹ :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ Real.rpow_nonneg
        (Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hP i).le q)
      hmoment (inv_nonneg.mpr hq.le)
  have hs : r / q < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos hr0 hq
  have hxq : ∀ i j, 0 < (a i j) ^ q := fun i j ↦
    Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (ha i j) q
  have hsuper := sum_powerCoordinate_le ω.positive hxq hs
  have hsumc :
      (∑ i, (c i) ^ q) ≤
        powerCoordinate ω.value (fun j ↦ ∑ i, (a i j) ^ q) (r / q) := by
    calc
      (∑ i, (c i) ^ q) =
          ∑ i, powerCoordinate ω.value (fun j ↦ (a i j) ^ q) (r / q) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact powerCoordinate_rpow_scale ω.positive (ha i) hr0.ne hq.ne'
      _ ≤ powerCoordinate ω.value (fun j ↦ ∑ i, (a i j) ^ q) (r / q) :=
        hsuper
  have hrootSuper :
      (∑ i, (c i) ^ q) ^ q⁻¹ ≤
        (powerCoordinate ω.value (fun j ↦ ∑ i, (a i j) ^ q)
          (r / q)) ^ q⁻¹ :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ Real.rpow_nonneg (hc i).le q)
      hsumc (inv_nonneg.mpr hq.le)
  have hasum : ∀ j, 0 < ∑ i, (a i j) ^ q := fun j ↦
    Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ ↦ Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (ha i j) q)
      Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hscale := powerCoordinate_root_scale ω.positive hasum hr0.ne hq.ne'
  have hfinal :
      (∑ i, (decreasingEigenvalues hP.isHermitian i) ^ q) ^ q⁻¹ ≤
        powerCoordinate ω.value
          (fun j ↦ (∑ i, (a i j) ^ q) ^ q⁻¹) r :=
    hrootMoment.trans (hrootSuper.trans_eq hscale)
  simpa only [schattenQ, P, a] using hfinal

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.sum_range_mul_nonpos
statement:
private lemma sum_range_mul_nonpos
    (n : ℕ) (c d : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i, i + 1 < n → c (i + 1) ≤ c i)
    (hd : ∀ k, k ≤ n → ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, d i ≤ 0)
    (htotal : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, d i = 0) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i * d i ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hparts := Finset.sum_range_by_parts c d n
  have hnonneg :
      0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1),
        (c (i + 1) - c i) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), d j := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i hi
    have hin : i + 1 < n := by
      have hi' : i < n - 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
      omega
    exact mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos
      (sub_nonpos.mpr (hc i hin)) (hd (i + 1) (by omega))
  rw [show (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i * d i) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i • d i by simp [smul_eq_mul],
    hparts, htotal]
  simpa using neg_nonpos.mpr hnonneg

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.sum_range_mul_nonpos_weak
statement:
private lemma sum_range_mul_nonpos_weak
    (n : ℕ) (c d : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hc0 : ∀ i, i < n → 0 ≤ c i)
    (hc : ∀ i, i + 1 < n → c (i + 1) ≤ c i)
    (hd : ∀ k, k ≤ n → ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, d i ≤ 0) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i * d i ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simp [hn]
  have hn0 : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
  have hparts := Finset.sum_range_by_parts c d n
  have hnonneg :
      0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1),
        (c (i + 1) - c i) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), d j := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i hi
    have hin : i + 1 < n := by
      have hi' : i < n - 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
      omega
    exact mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos
      (sub_nonpos.mpr (hc i hin)) (hd (i + 1) (by omega))
  have hfirst :
      c (n - 1) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, d i ≤ 0 :=
    mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos
      (hc0 (n - 1) (by omega)) (hd n le_rfl)
  rw [show (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i * d i) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i • d i by simp [smul_eq_mul], hparts]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  linarith

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.exp_sub_exp_le_tangent
proof:
:= by
  have hmul :
      Real.exp (t * a) * (t * (b - a) + 1) ≤ Real.exp (t * b) := by
    calc
      Real.exp (t * a) * (t * (b - a) + 1) ≤
          Real.exp (t * a) * Real.exp (t * (b - a)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.add_one_le_exp _) (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp (t * b) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
  calc
    Real.exp (t * a) - Real.exp (t * b) ≤
        Real.exp (t * a) -
          Real.exp (t * a) * (t * (b - a) + 1) :=
      sub_le_sub_left hmul _
    _ = (t * Real.exp (t * a)) * (a - b) := by ring

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.sum_exp_le_sum_exp_of_antitone
statement:
theorem sum_exp_le_sum_exp_of_antitone
    {n : ℕ} {x y : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hx : Antitone x) (_hy : Antitone y)
    (hprefix : ∀ k, k ≤ n → prefixSum x k ≤ prefixSum y k)
    (htotal : prefixSum x n = prefixSum y n)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∑ i, Real.exp (t * x i)) ≤ ∑ i, Real.exp (t * y i)
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℕ → ℝ := fun i ↦ t * Real.exp (t * natAt x i)
  let d : ℕ → ℝ := fun i ↦ natAt x i - natAt y i
  have hc : ∀ i, i + 1 < n → c (i + 1) ≤ c i := by
    intro i hi
    have hxi : x ⟨i + 1, hi⟩ ≤ x ⟨i, by omega⟩ :=
      hx (by simp only [Fin.mk_le_mk]; omega)
    have hexp : Real.exp (t * x ⟨i + 1, hi⟩) ≤
        Real.exp (t * x ⟨i, by omega⟩) :=
      Real.exp_monotone (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxi ht.le)
    simpa [c, natAt, hi, show i < n by omega] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp ht.le
  have hd : ∀ k, k ≤ n → ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, d i ≤ 0 := by
    intro k hk
    have hle := hprefix k hk
    rw [prefixSum, prefixSum] at hle
    simpa [d, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] using sub_nonpos.mpr hle
  have hdtotal : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, d i = 0 := by
    rw [show (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, d i) = prefixSum x n - prefixSum y n by
      simp [d, prefixSum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr htotal
  have hweighted : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i * d i ≤ 0 :=
    sum_range_mul_nonpos n c d hc hd hdtotal
  have hpoint : ∀ i : Fin n,
      Real.exp (t * x i) - Real.exp (t * y i) ≤
        (t * Real.exp (t * x i)) * (x i - y i) :=
    fun i ↦ exp_sub_exp_le_tangent t (x i) (y i)
  have hsum :
      (∑ i, (Real.exp (t * x i) - Real.exp (t * y i))) ≤
        ∑ i, (t * Real.exp (t * x i)) * (x i - y i) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ hpoint i
  have hright :
      (∑ i, (t * Real.exp (t * x i)) * (x i - y i)) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i * d i := by
    calc
      (∑ i, (t * Real.exp (t * x i)) * (x i - y i)) =
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, if hi : i < n then
            (t * Real.exp (t * x ⟨i, hi⟩)) * (x ⟨i, hi⟩ - y ⟨i, hi⟩)
          else 0 := Finset.sum_fin_eq_sum_range _
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i * d i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hin : i < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
        simp [c, d, natAt, hin]
  rw [hright] at hsum
  have hdiff :
      (∑ i, Real.exp (t * x i)) - (∑ i, Real.exp (t * y i)) ≤ 0 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact hsum.trans hweighted
  exact sub_nonpos.mp hdiff

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.sum_exp_le_sum_exp_of_fin_prefix
statement:
theorem sum_exp_le_sum_exp_of_fin_prefix
    {n : ℕ} {x y : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hx : Antitone x) (hy : Antitone y)
    (hprefix : ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n),
      (∑ i : Fin k, x (Fin.castLE hk i)) ≤
        ∑ i : Fin k, y (Fin.castLE hk i))
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∑ i, Real.exp (t * x i)) ≤ ∑ i, Real.exp (t * y i)
proof:

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.Majorized.sum_exp_le_sum_exp
statement:
theorem Majorized.sum_exp_le_sum_exp
    {n : ℕ} {x y : Fin n → ℝ} (h : Majorized x y)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∑ i, Real.exp (t * x i)) ≤ ∑ i, Real.exp (t * y i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨leftPerm, rightPerm, hleft, hright, hprefix, htotal⟩ := h
  have hs := sum_exp_le_sum_exp_of_antitone
    hleft hright hprefix htotal ht
  calc
    (∑ i, Real.exp (t * x i)) =
        ∑ i, Real.exp (t * x (leftPerm i)) :=
      (Equiv.sum_comp leftPerm (fun a ↦ Real.exp (t * x a))).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ i, Real.exp (t * y (rightPerm i)) := hs
    _ = ∑ i, Real.exp (t * y i) :=
      Equiv.sum_comp rightPerm (fun a ↦ Real.exp (t * y a))

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.det_ge_prod_of_normalized_trace_bound
statement:
theorem det_ge_prod_of_normalized_trace_bound
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hY : Y.PosDef)
    {q : Fin n → ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (ht : 0 < t)
    (htrace :
      ∑ i, (q i / decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i) ^ t ≤ (n : ℝ)) :
    ∏ i, q i ≤ RCLike.re Y.det
proof:
:= by
  have hscalar :
      (∏ i, q i) ≤ ∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i :=
    product_le_product_of_sum_rpow_div_le_card
      hq (Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hY) ht htrace
  calc
    (∏ i, q i) ≤ ∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i := hscalar
    _ = ∏ i, hY.isHermitian.eigenvalues i :=
      prod_comp_decreasingEigenvalues_eq_eigenvalues hY.isHermitian id
    _ = RCLike.re Y.det := by
      have hdet := congrArg RCLike.re hY.isHermitian.det_eq_prod_eigenvalues
      have hre_prod :
          RCLike.re (∏ i, (hY.isHermitian.eigenvalues i : 𝕜)) =
            ∏ i, hY.isHermitian.eigenvalues i := by
        classical
        induction (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) using Finset.induction_on with
        | empty => simp
        | @insert i s hi ih =>
            simp only [Finset.prod_insert hi]
            simp [ih]
      exact hre_prod.symm.trans hdet.symm

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.powerCoordinate_rpow_order_of_ne
statement:
theorem powerCoordinate_rpow_order_of_ne {m : ℕ} [NeZero m]
    {w x : Fin m → ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 < x j) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    (powerCoordinate w x t) ^ t = ∑ j, w j * (x j) ^ t
proof:
:= by
  let s : ℝ := ∑ j, w j * (x j) ^ t
  have hs : 0 < s := Finset.sum_pos
    (fun j _ ↦ mul_pos (hw j) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hx j) t))
    Finset.univ_nonempty
  unfold powerCoordinate
  change (s ^ t⁻¹) ^ t = s
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul hs.le]
  simp [ht]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.powerCoordinate_rpow_order
statement:
theorem powerCoordinate_rpow_order {m : ℕ} [NeZero m]
    {w x : Fin m → ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 < x j) (ht : 0 < t) :
    (powerCoordinate w x t) ^ t = ∑ j, w j * (x j) ^ t
proof:
:=
  powerCoordinate_rpow_order_of_ne hw hx ht.ne'

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.powerCoordinate_div_rpow_of_ne
statement:
theorem powerCoordinate_div_rpow_of_ne {m : ℕ} [NeZero m]
    {w x : Fin m → ℝ} {y t : ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 < x j) (hy : 0 < y) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    (powerCoordinate w x t / y) ^ t =
      ∑ j, w j * (x j / y) ^ t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.div_rpow (powerCoordinate_pos hw hx).le hy.le,
    powerCoordinate_rpow_order_of_ne hw hx ht]
  simp_rw [Real.div_rpow (hx _).le hy.le]
  rw [Finset.sum_div]
  congr 1
  funext j
  ring

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.powerCoordinate_div_rpow
statement:
theorem powerCoordinate_div_rpow {m : ℕ} [NeZero m]
    {w x : Fin m → ℝ} {y t : ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 < x j) (hy : 0 < y) (ht : 0 < t) :
    (powerCoordinate w x t / y) ^ t =
      ∑ j, w j * (x j / y) ^ t
proof:
:=
  powerCoordinate_div_rpow_of_ne hw hx hy ht.ne'

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.powerCoordinate_mono
statement:
theorem powerCoordinate_mono {m : ℕ} {w x z : Fin m → ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j)
    (hxz : ∀ j, x j ≤ z j) (ht : 0 < t) :
    powerCoordinate w x t ≤ powerCoordinate w z t
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.rpow_le_rpow
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ ↦ mul_nonneg (hw j) (Real.rpow_nonneg (hx j) t)
  · exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (Real.rpow_le_rpow (hx j) (hxz j) ht.le) (hw j)
  · exact inv_nonneg.2 ht.le

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.inv_powerCoordinate_invs
statement:
theorem inv_powerCoordinate_invs {m : ℕ} [NeZero m]
    {w a : Fin m → ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (ha : ∀ j, 0 < a j) :
    (powerCoordinate w (fun j ↦ (a j)⁻¹) t)⁻¹ =
      powerCoordinate w a (-t)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      (∑ j, w j * ((a j)⁻¹) ^ t) = ∑ j, w j * (a j) ^ (-t) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg_eq_inv_rpow]
  have hbase : 0 < ∑ j, w j * (a j) ^ (-t) :=
    Finset.sum_pos
      (fun j _ ↦ mul_pos (hw j) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (ha j) (-t)))
      Finset.univ_nonempty
  unfold powerCoordinate
  rw [hsum, inv_neg]
  exact (Real.rpow_neg hbase.le t⁻¹).symm

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.Matrix.PosDef.half_mul_half
statement:
theorem Matrix.PosDef.half_mul_half
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) = A
proof:
:= by
  have h := CFC.rpow_add (a := A) (x := (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    (y := (1 / 2 : ℝ)) hA.isUnit
  norm_num [CFC.rpow_one A hA.posSemidef.nonneg] at h ⊢
  exact h.symm

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.det_relative_mul_det
statement:
theorem det_relative_mul_det
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {B Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hY : Y.PosDef) :
    (relativeMatrix Y B).det * Y.det = B.det
proof:
:= by
  let S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := Y ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  have hSYS : S * Y * S = 1 := by
    simpa [S] using Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_conjugate_self hY
  have hdetSYS := congrArg Matrix.det hSYS
  simp only [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_one] at hdetSYS
  calc
    (relativeMatrix Y B).det * Y.det =
        (S.det * B.det * S.det) * Y.det := by
      simp [relativeMatrix, S, Matrix.det_mul]
    _ = (S.det * Y.det * S.det) * B.det := by ring
    _ = B.det := by rw [hdetSYS, one_mul]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.coe_prod_decreasingEigenvalues_eq_det
statement:
theorem coe_prod_decreasingEigenvalues_eq_det
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    RCLike.ofReal (∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hA.isHermitian i) = A.det
proof:
:= by
  have hprod :=
    prod_comp_decreasingEigenvalues_eq_eigenvalues hA.isHermitian id
  change (∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hA.isHermitian i) =
    ∏ i, hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i at hprod
  rw [hprod]
  rw [show RCLike.ofReal (∏ i, hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) =
      ∏ i, RCLike.ofReal (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) by
        exact map_prod (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) _ Finset.univ]
  exact hA.isHermitian.det_eq_prod_eigenvalues.symm

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.prod_relative_mul_prod
statement:
theorem prod_relative_mul_prod
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {B Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hB : B.PosDef) (hY : Y.PosDef) :
    (∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues
      (relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB).isHermitian i) *
        (∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i) =
      ∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian i
proof:
:= by
  apply RCLike.ofReal_injective (K := 𝕜)
  rw [RCLike.ofReal_mul,
    coe_prod_decreasingEigenvalues_eq_det (relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB),
    coe_prod_decreasingEigenvalues_eq_det hY,
    coe_prod_decreasingEigenvalues_eq_det hB]
  exact det_relative_mul_det hY

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.sum_log_ratio_eq_sum_log_relative
statement:
theorem sum_log_ratio_eq_sum_log_relative
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {B Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hB : B.PosDef) (hY : Y.PosDef) :
    (∑ i, (Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian i) -
      Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i))) =
      ∑ i, Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues
        (relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB).isHermitian i)
proof:
:= by
  let D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := relativeMatrix Y B
  have hD : D.PosDef := relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB
  have hb : ∀ i, 0 < decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian i :=
    Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hB
  have hy : ∀ i, 0 < decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i :=
    Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hY
  have hd : ∀ i, 0 < decreasingEigenvalues hD.isHermitian i :=
    Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hD
  have hprod := prod_relative_mul_prod hB hY
  change (∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hD.isHermitian i) *
      (∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i) =
    ∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian i at hprod
  have hyprod : (∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i) ≠ 0 :=
    (Finset.prod_pos fun i _ ↦ hy i).ne'
  have hratio :
      (∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hD.isHermitian i) =
        (∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian i) /
          ∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i :=
    (eq_div_iff hyprod).2 hprod
  calc
    (∑ i, (Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian i) -
        Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i))) =
        Real.log (∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian i) -
          Real.log (∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
        Real.log_prod (fun i _ ↦ (hb i).ne'),
        Real.log_prod (fun i _ ↦ (hy i).ne')]
    _ = Real.log ((∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian i) /
          ∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i) := by
      rw [Real.log_div
        (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ ↦ (hb i).ne') hyprod]
    _ = Real.log (∏ i, decreasingEigenvalues hD.isHermitian i) := by
      rw [hratio]
    _ = ∑ i, Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hD.isHermitian i) :=
      Real.log_prod (fun i _ ↦ (hd i).ne')

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.exists_perm_antitone
statement:
theorem exists_perm_antitone {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∃ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), Antitone (fun i ↦ x (p i))
proof:
:= by
  let p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) := Tuple.sort (fun i ↦ -x i)
  refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
  have hp : Monotone ((fun i ↦ -x i) ∘ p) :=
    Tuple.monotone_sort (fun i ↦ -x i)
  intro i j hij
  have hpij := hp hij
  change -x (p i) ≤ -x (p j) at hpij
  linarith

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.decreasingEigenvalues_congr
statement:
lemma decreasingEigenvalues_congr
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A C : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (h : A = C) :
    decreasingEigenvalues hA = decreasingEigenvalues hC
proof:
:= by
  subst C
  rfl

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.selectedProducts_of_gram
statement:
theorem selectedProducts_of_gram
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (hgram : SelectedGramProduct 𝕜) : LidskiiSelectedProducts 𝕜
proof:
:= by
  intro n _ B Y hB hY p k hk0 hk
  let R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := B ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := Y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := Y ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  let S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := R * Z
  have hRstar : R.conjTranspose = R :=
    (Matrix.PosDef.rpow hB _).isHermitian.eq
  have hQstar : Q.conjTranspose = Q :=
    (Matrix.PosDef.rpow hY _).isHermitian.eq
  have hZstar : Z.conjTranspose = Z :=
    (Matrix.PosDef.rpow hY _).isHermitian.eq
  have hRR : R * R = B := by
    simpa [R] using Matrix.PosDef.half_mul_half hB
  have hQQ : Q * Q = Y := by
    simpa [Q] using Matrix.PosDef.half_mul_half hY
  have hZQ : Z * Q = 1 := by
    simpa [Z, Q] using Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_mul_half hY
  have hST : S * Q = R := by
    simp only [S]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hZQ, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hSTgram : (S * Q).conjTranspose * (S * Q) = B := by
    rw [hST, hRstar, hRR]
  have hSgram : S.conjTranspose * S = relativeMatrix Y B := by
    simp only [S, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hRstar, hZstar]
    calc
      (Z * R) * (R * Z) = Z * (R * R) * Z := by noncomm_ring
      _ = Z * B * Z := by rw [hRR]
      _ = relativeMatrix Y B := rfl
  have hQgram : Q.conjTranspose * Q = Y := by rw [hQstar, hQQ]
  have h := hgram n S Q p k hk0 hk
  have hSTeigs := decreasingEigenvalues_congr
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (S * Q)) hB.isHermitian hSTgram
  have hSeigs := decreasingEigenvalues_congr
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self S)
    (relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB).isHermitian hSgram
  have hQeigs := decreasingEigenvalues_congr
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self Q) hY.isHermitian hQgram
  rw [hSTeigs, hSeigs, hQeigs] at h
  have hprodY : 0 < prefixProd
      (fun i ↦ decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian (p i)) k hk.le :=
    prefixProd_pos
      (fun i ↦ Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hY _) k hk.le
  rw [prefixProd, prefixProd, Finset.prod_div_distrib]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hprodY).2
  simpa [prefixProd, mul_comm] using h

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ratioProducts_of_selectedProducts
statement:
theorem ratioProducts_of_selectedProducts
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (hselected : LidskiiSelectedProducts 𝕜) : LidskiiRatioProducts 𝕜
proof:
:= by
  intro n _ B Y hB hY
  let x : Fin n → ℝ := fun i ↦
    Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian i) -
      Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i)
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_perm_antitone x
  refine ⟨p, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [x] using hp
  · intro k hk0 hk
    exact hselected n B Y hB hY p k hk0 hk

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.lidskiiProperPrefix_of_ratioProducts
statement:
theorem lidskiiProperPrefix_of_ratioProducts
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (hproducts : LidskiiRatioProducts 𝕜) : LidskiiProperPrefix 𝕜
proof:
:= by
  intro n _ B Y hB hY
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hproduct⟩ := hproducts n B Y hB hY
  refine ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  by_cases hk0 : k = 0
  · subst k
    simp [prefixSum]
  have hkpos : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk0
  have hkn : k ≤ n := hk.le
  have hb : ∀ i, 0 < decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian i :=
    Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hB
  have hy : ∀ i, 0 < decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i :=
    Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hY
  have hd : ∀ i, 0 < decreasingEigenvalues
      (relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB).isHermitian i :=
    Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos (relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB)
  rw [prefixSum_eq_sum_fin _ k hkn, prefixSum_eq_sum_fin _ k hkn]
  have hleft :
      (∑ i : Fin k,
        (Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian
            (p (Fin.castLE hkn i))) -
          Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian
            (p (Fin.castLE hkn i))))) =
        Real.log (prefixProd (fun i ↦
          decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian (p i) /
            decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian (p i)) k hkn) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ i : Fin k, Real.log
          (decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian (p (Fin.castLE hkn i)) /
            decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian (p (Fin.castLE hkn i))) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [Real.log_div (hb _).ne' (hy _).ne']
      _ = Real.log (prefixProd (fun i ↦
          decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian (p i) /
            decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian (p i)) k hkn) := by
        rw [prefixProd, Real.log_prod]
        intro i _
        exact (div_pos (hb _) (hy _)).ne'
  have hright :
      (∑ i : Fin k, Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues
        (relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB).isHermitian (Fin.castLE hkn i))) =
        Real.log (prefixProd (decreasingEigenvalues
          (relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB).isHermitian) k hkn) := by
    rw [prefixProd, Real.log_prod]
    intro i _
    exact (hd _).ne'
  rw [hleft, hright]
  exact Real.strictMonoOn_log.monotoneOn
    (prefixProd_pos (fun i ↦ div_pos (hb _) (hy _)) k hkn)
    (prefixProd_pos hd k hkn)
    (hproduct k hkpos hk)

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.toEuclideanLin_mul
statement:
lemma toEuclideanLin_mul
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) :
    Matrix.toEuclideanLin (A * B) =
      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A).comp (Matrix.toEuclideanLin B)
proof:
:= by
  ext v i
  simp [Matrix.toLpLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.star_conjTranspose_mulVec
statement:
lemma star_conjTranspose_mulVec
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) (x : Fin n → 𝕜) :
    star (A.conjTranspose.mulVec x) = Matrix.vecMul (star x) A
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change star (∑ j, star (A j i) * x j) = ∑ j, star (x j) * A j i
  simp [mul_comm]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.adjoint_toEuclideanLin
statement:
lemma adjoint_toEuclideanLin
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) :
    LinearMap.adjoint (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A) =
      Matrix.toEuclideanLin A.conjTranspose
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply (LinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff _ _).2
  intro x y
  simp only [Matrix.toLpLin_apply,
    EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
  rw [star_conjTranspose_mulVec]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.symmetricEigenvalues_congr
statement:
lemma symmetricEigenvalues_congr
    {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
    [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E]
    {L M : E →ₗ[𝕜] E}
    (hL : L.IsSymmetric) (hM : M.IsSymmetric) (h : L = M)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : Module.finrank 𝕜 E = n) :
    hL.eigenvalues hn = hM.eigenvalues hn
proof:
:= by
  subst M
  rfl

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.singularValues_sq_eq_decreasingEigenvalues_gram
statement:
lemma singularValues_sq_eq_decreasingEigenvalues_gram
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) (i : Fin n) :
    (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A).singularValues i ^ 2 =
      decreasingEigenvalues
        (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A) i
proof:
:= by
  let ii : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin n)) :=
    finCongr (Fintype.card_fin n).symm i
  have hfin : Module.finrank 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n)) =
      Fintype.card (Fin n) := by
    simp
  have hs := LinearMap.sq_singularValues_fin
    (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A) hfin ii
  have hgramlin :
      (LinearMap.adjoint (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A)).comp
          (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A) =
        Matrix.toEuclideanLin (A.conjTranspose * A) := by
    rw [adjoint_toEuclideanLin, toEuclideanLin_mul]
  have heigs := symmetricEigenvalues_congr
    (LinearMap.isSymmetric_adjoint_comp_self (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A))
    (Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A)) hgramlin hfin
  rw [heigs] at hs
  simpa [decreasingEigenvalues, Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀, ii] using hs

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.lidskii_of_properPrefix
statement:
theorem lidskii_of_properPrefix
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (hprefix : LidskiiProperPrefix 𝕜) : Lidskii 𝕜
proof:
:= by
  intro n _ B Y hB hY
  let x : Fin n → ℝ := fun i ↦
    Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian i) -
      Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i)
  let y : Fin n → ℝ := fun i ↦ Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues
    (relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB).isHermitian i)
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hproper⟩ := hprefix n B Y hB hY
  have hy0 : ∀ i, 0 < decreasingEigenvalues
      (relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB).isHermitian i :=
    Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos (relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB)
  have hy : Antitone y := by
    intro i j hij
    exact Real.strictMonoOn_log.monotoneOn (by simpa [y] using hy0 j)
      (by simpa [y] using hy0 i)
      (decreasingEigenvalues_antitone
        (relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB).isHermitian hij)
  have htotal : (∑ i, x i) = ∑ i, y i := by
    simpa [x, y] using sum_log_ratio_eq_sum_log_relative hB hY
  refine ⟨p, Equiv.refl (Fin n), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [x] using hp
  · simpa using hy
  · intro k hk
    by_cases hkn : k = n
    · subst k
      rw [prefixSum_card, prefixSum_card]
      calc
        (∑ i, x (p i)) = ∑ i, x i := Equiv.sum_comp p x
        _ = ∑ i, y i := htotal
        _ ≤ ∑ i, y ((Equiv.refl (Fin n)) i) := by simp
    · simpa [x, y] using hproper k (lt_of_le_of_ne hk hkn)
  · rw [prefixSum_card, prefixSum_card]
    calc
      (∑ i, x (p i)) = ∑ i, x i := Equiv.sum_comp p x
      _ = ∑ i, y i := htotal
      _ = ∑ i, y ((Equiv.refl (Fin n)) i) := by simp

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.lidskii_of_gram
statement:
theorem lidskii_of_gram

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.lidskii_dim_one
statement:
theorem lidskii_dim_one
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (B Y : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) 𝕜)
    (hB : B.PosDef) (hY : Y.PosDef) :
    Majorized
      (fun i ↦ Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian i) -
        Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i))
      (fun i ↦ Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues
        (relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB).isHermitian i))
proof:
:= by
  let x : Fin 1 → ℝ := fun i ↦
    Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian i) -
      Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i)
  let y : Fin 1 → ℝ := fun i ↦ Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues
    (relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB).isHermitian i)
  have htotal : (∑ i, x i) = ∑ i, y i := by
    simpa [x, y] using sum_log_ratio_eq_sum_log_relative hB hY
  refine ⟨Equiv.refl (Fin 1), Equiv.refl (Fin 1), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j _
    rw [Subsingleton.elim i j]
  · intro i j _
    rw [Subsingleton.elim i j]
  · intro k hk
    have hk_cases : k = 0 ∨ k = 1 := by omega
    rcases hk_cases with rfl | rfl
    · simp [prefixSum]
    · change prefixSum x 1 ≤ prefixSum y 1
      rw [prefixSum_card, prefixSum_card]
      exact htotal.le
  · change prefixSum x 1 = prefixSum y 1
    rw [prefixSum_card, prefixSum_card]
    exact htotal

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.Matrix.PosDef.rpow
statement:
theorem Matrix.PosDef.rpow {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (t : ℝ) :

:= by
  apply CFC.rpow_nonneg.posSemidef.posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr
  exact hA.isUnit.cfcRpow t hA.posSemidef.nonneg

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.Matrix.PosDef.inv_rpow
statement:
theorem Matrix.PosDef.inv_rpow {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (t : ℝ) :
    A⁻¹ ^ t = A ^ (-t)
proof:
:= by
  let u : (Matrix n n 𝕜)ˣ := hA.isUnit.unit
  have hu : (u : Matrix n n 𝕜) = A := hA.isUnit.unit_spec
  have h := CFC.rpow_neg u t hA.posSemidef.nonneg
  simpa [hu] using h.symm

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.Matrix.PosDef.rpow_inv
statement:
theorem Matrix.PosDef.rpow_inv {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (t : ℝ) :
    (A ^ t)⁻¹ = A ^ (-t)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : t = 0
  · subst t
    simp [CFC.rpow_zero A hA.posSemidef.nonneg]
  · rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse]
    exact CFC.inverse_rpow A t ht hA.isStrictlyPositive

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_mul_half
statement:
theorem Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_mul_half {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact CFC.rpow_neg_mul_rpow (1 / 2 : ℝ) hA.isStrictlyPositive

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.Matrix.PosDef.half_mul_invHalf
statement:
theorem Matrix.PosDef.half_mul_invHalf {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact CFC.rpow_mul_rpow_neg (1 / 2 : ℝ) hA.isStrictlyPositive

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_conjugate_self
proof:
:= by
  let R : Matrix n n 𝕜 := A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hRR : R * R = A := by
    have h := CFC.rpow_add (a := A) (x := (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (y := (1 / 2 : ℝ)) hA.isUnit
    norm_num [CFC.rpow_one A hA.posSemidef.nonneg] at h ⊢
    exact h.symm
  calc
    A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * A * A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) =
        A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * (R * R) * A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by rw [hRR]
    _ =
        (A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * R) *
          (R * A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = 1 := by
      rw [show A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * R = 1 from
          Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_mul_half hA,
        show R * A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) = 1 from
          Matrix.PosDef.half_mul_invHalf hA, one_mul]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.weightedGeometricMean_posDef
statement:
theorem weightedGeometricMean_posDef
    {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (t : ℝ) :
    (weightedGeometricMean A B t).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  let S : Matrix n n 𝕜 := A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  have hS : S.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hA _
  have hinner : (S * B * S).PosDef := by
    have hSstar : Sᴴ = S := hS.isHermitian.eq
    simpa only [hSstar] using hB.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
      (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hS.isUnit)
  let R : Matrix n n 𝕜 := A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hR : R.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hA _
  have hRstar : Rᴴ = R := hR.isHermitian.eq
  simpa only [weightedGeometricMean, show A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) = S from rfl,
    show A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) = R from rfl, hRstar] using
      (Matrix.PosDef.rpow hinner t).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
        (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hR.isUnit)

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.weightedGeometricMean_inv
statement:
theorem weightedGeometricMean_inv
    {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (t : ℝ) :
    (weightedGeometricMean A B t)⁻¹ =
      weightedGeometricMean A⁻¹ B⁻¹ t
proof:
:= by
  let R : Matrix n n 𝕜 := A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let S : Matrix n n 𝕜 := A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  let D : Matrix n n 𝕜 := S * B * S
  have hS : S.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hA _
  have hD : D.PosDef := by
    have hSstar : S.conjTranspose = S := hS.isHermitian.eq
    simpa only [D, hSstar] using hB.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
      (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hS.isUnit)
  have hRinv : R⁻¹ = S := by
    simpa [R, S] using Matrix.PosDef.rpow_inv hA (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hSinv : S⁻¹ = R := by
    simpa [R, S] using Matrix.PosDef.rpow_inv hA (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  have hDtinv : (D ^ t)⁻¹ = D ^ (-t) :=
    Matrix.PosDef.rpow_inv hD t
  have hAinvHalf : A⁻¹ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) = S := by
    simpa [S] using Matrix.PosDef.inv_rpow hA (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hAinvInvHalf : A⁻¹ ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) = R := by
    simpa [R] using Matrix.PosDef.inv_rpow hA (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  have hDinv : D⁻¹ = R * B⁻¹ * R := by
    calc
      D⁻¹ = (S * B * S)⁻¹ := rfl
      _ = S⁻¹ * B⁻¹ * S⁻¹ := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = R * B⁻¹ * R := by rw [hSinv]
  have hDinvPow : D⁻¹ ^ t = D ^ (-t) := Matrix.PosDef.inv_rpow hD t
  calc
    (weightedGeometricMean A B t)⁻¹ = (R * D ^ t * R)⁻¹ := rfl
    _ = R⁻¹ * (D ^ t)⁻¹ * R⁻¹ := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = S * D ^ (-t) * S := by rw [hRinv, hDtinv]
    _ = weightedGeometricMean A⁻¹ B⁻¹ t := by
      simp only [weightedGeometricMean, hAinvHalf, hAinvInvHalf]
      rw [← hDinv, hDinvPow]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.normalize_positivePowerMeanMap
statement:
theorem normalize_positivePowerMeanMap
    (w : m → ℝ) (A : m → Matrix n n 𝕜) (t : ℝ)
    {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hX : X.PosDef) :
    X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * positivePowerMeanMap w A t X *
        X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) =
      ∑ j, w j •
        (X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * A j * X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) ^ t
proof:
:= by
  let S : Matrix n n 𝕜 := X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  let R : Matrix n n 𝕜 := X ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hSR : S * R = 1 := Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_mul_half hX
  have hRS : R * S = 1 := Matrix.PosDef.half_mul_invHalf hX
  calc
    S * positivePowerMeanMap w A t X * S =
        ∑ j, w j • (S * weightedGeometricMean X (A j) t * S) := by
          simp only [positivePowerMeanMap, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul,
            mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
    _ = ∑ j, w j • (S * R * (S * A j * S) ^ t * R * S) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      congr 1
      simp only [weightedGeometricMean, S, R]
      noncomm_ring
    _ = ∑ j, w j • (S * A j * S) ^ t := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      congr 1
      calc
        S * R * (S * A j * S) ^ t * R * S =
            (S * R) * (S * A j * S) ^ t * (R * S) := by noncomm_ring
        _ = (S * A j * S) ^ t := by rw [hSR, hRS, one_mul, mul_one]
    _ = ∑ j, w j •
        (X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * A j * X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) ^ t := rfl

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.prefixProd_increasingEigenvalues_eq_prod_bottom
statement:
theorem prefixProd_increasingEigenvalues_eq_prod_bottom
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    prefixProd (increasingEigenvalues hA) k hkn =
      ∏ i : Fin k, decreasingEigenvalues hA (bottomFinEmbedding hkn i)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    prefixProd (increasingEigenvalues hA) k hkn =
        ∏ i : Fin k, decreasingEigenvalues hA (Fin.castLE hkn i).rev := rfl
    _ = ∏ i : Fin k,
        decreasingEigenvalues hA (bottomFinEmbedding hkn i.rev) := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [bottomFinEmbedding_rev_castLE]
    _ = ∏ i : Fin k,
        decreasingEigenvalues hA (bottomFinEmbedding hkn i) :=
      (Equiv.prod_comp (Fin.revPerm : Fin k ≃ Fin k)
        (fun i : Fin k ↦ decreasingEigenvalues hA
          (bottomFinEmbedding hkn i)))

:= by

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.IsMean.lowerProductDominates
statement:
theorem IsMean.lowerProductDominates
    {n m : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero m]
    {w : Fin m → ℝ} {A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    {t : ℝ} {Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hY : IsMean w A t Y)
    (hLidskii : Lidskii ℂ)
    (hAndo : ∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k],
      Ando ℂ (Fin n) (Fin k))
    (hInterlace : Interlacing ℂ)
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (hA : ∀ j, (A j).PosDef)
    (ht0 : 0 < t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    LowerProductDominates
      (increasingEigenvalues hY.posDef.isHermitian)
      (fun i ↦ powerCoordinate w
        (fun j ↦ increasingEigenvalues (hA j).isHermitian i) t)
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk0 hkn
  letI : NeZero k := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt hk0⟩
  let V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℂ :=
    bottomEigenvectorIsometry hY.posDef hkn
  let Yk : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ := shorted V Y
  let C : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ := fun j ↦ shorted V (A j)
  have hV : MatrixIsometry V := bottomEigenvectorIsometry_isometry hY.posDef hkn
  have hYk : Yk.PosDef := shorted_posDef hV hY.posDef
  have hC : ∀ j, (C j).PosDef := fun j ↦ shorted_posDef hV (hA j)
  have hgeo (j : Fin m) :
      weightedGeometricMean Yk (C j) t ≤
        shorted V (weightedGeometricMean Y (A j) t) := by
    exact weightedGeometricMean_shorted_le (hAndo k) hV
      hY.posDef (hA j) ht0.le ht1
  have hsumGeo :
      (∑ j, w j • weightedGeometricMean Yk (C j) t) ≤
        ∑ j, w j • shorted V (weightedGeometricMean Y (A j) t) := by
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦
      smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left (hgeo j) (hw j).le
  have hsuperadd :
      (∑ j, w j • shorted V (weightedGeometricMean Y (A j) t)) ≤
        shorted V (∑ j, w j • weightedGeometricMean Y (A j) t) := by
    exact shorted_superadditive hV w hw
      (fun j ↦ weightedGeometricMean Y (A j) t)
      (fun j ↦ weightedGeometricMean_posDef hY.posDef (hA j) t)
  have hsumEq :
      (∑ j, w j • weightedGeometricMean Y (A j) t) = Y := by
    exact hY.fixedPoint.symm
  have hYkSuper : IsSuper w C t Yk := by
    refine ⟨hYk, ?_⟩
    change (∑ j, w j • weightedGeometricMean Yk (C j) t) ≤ Yk
    calc
      (∑ j, w j • weightedGeometricMean Yk (C j) t) ≤
          ∑ j, w j • shorted V (weightedGeometricMean Y (A j) t) := hsumGeo
      _ ≤ shorted V (∑ j, w j • weightedGeometricMean Y (A j) t) := hsuperadd
      _ = Yk := by rw [hsumEq]
  have hdet := hYkSuper.powerCoordinateProd_le_det
    hLidskii hw hC ht0
  have hcoord (i : Fin k) :
      powerCoordinate w
          (fun j ↦ increasingEigenvalues (hA j).isHermitian
            (Fin.castLE hkn i)) t ≤
        powerCoordinate w
          (fun j ↦ increasingEigenvalues (hC j).isHermitian i) t := by
    apply powerCoordinate_mono (fun j ↦ (hw j).le)
      (fun j ↦ (Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos (hA j)
        (Fin.castLE hkn i).rev).le)
      (fun j ↦ increasingEigenvalues_le_shorted
        hInterlace hkn (hA j) hV i) ht0
  have hprodCoord :
      prefixProd
          (fun i ↦ powerCoordinate w
            (fun j ↦ increasingEigenvalues (hA j).isHermitian i) t)
          k hkn ≤
        ∏ i : Fin k, powerCoordinate w
          (fun j ↦ increasingEigenvalues (hC j).isHermitian i) t := by
    unfold prefixProd
    exact Finset.prod_le_prod
      (fun i _ ↦ powerCoordinate_nonneg (fun j ↦ (hw j).le)
        (fun j ↦ (Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos (hA j)
          (Fin.castLE hkn i).rev).le))
      (fun i _ ↦ hcoord i)
  calc
    prefixProd
        (fun i ↦ powerCoordinate w
          (fun j ↦ increasingEigenvalues (hA j).isHermitian i) t)
        k hkn ≤
        ∏ i : Fin k, powerCoordinate w
          (fun j ↦ increasingEigenvalues (hC j).isHermitian i) t := hprodCoord
    _ = ∏ i : Fin k, powerCoordinate w
          (fun j ↦ decreasingEigenvalues (hC j).isHermitian i) t := by
      simpa [increasingEigenvalues] using
        (Equiv.prod_comp (Fin.revPerm : Fin k ≃ Fin k)
          (fun i : Fin k ↦ powerCoordinate w
            (fun j ↦ decreasingEigenvalues (hC j).isHermitian i) t))
    _ ≤ RCLike.re Yk.det := hdet
    _ = ∏ i : Fin k,
        decreasingEigenvalues hY.posDef.isHermitian
          (bottomFinEmbedding hkn i) := by
      exact (shorted_bottomEigenvectors hY.posDef hkn).2
    _ = prefixProd (increasingEigenvalues hY.posDef.isHermitian) k hkn :=
      (prefixProd_increasingEigenvalues_eq_prod_bottom
        hY.posDef.isHermitian hkn).symm

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.negativePowerMean_weakLogMajorized_of_isMean
statement:
theorem negativePowerMean_weakLogMajorized_of_isMean
    {n m : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero m]
    (hLidskii : Lidskii ℂ)
    (hAndo : ∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k],
      Ando ℂ (Fin n) (Fin k))
    (hInterlace : Interlacing ℂ)
    {w : Fin m → ℝ} {A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    {t : ℝ} {Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (hA : ∀ j, (A j).PosDef)
    (ht0 : 0 < t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1)
    (hY : IsMean w (fun j ↦ (A j)⁻¹) t Y) :
    WeakLogMajorized
      (decreasingEigenvalues hY.posDef.inv.isHermitian)
      (fun i ↦ powerCoordinate w
        (fun j ↦ decreasingEigenvalues (hA j).isHermitian i) (-t))
proof:
:= by
  let a : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ :=
    fun j i ↦ decreasingEigenvalues (hA j).isHermitian i
  let q : Fin n → ℝ := fun i ↦
    powerCoordinate w (fun j ↦ (a j i)⁻¹) t
  have hInvA : ∀ j, ((A j)⁻¹).PosDef := fun j ↦ (hA j).inv
  have hlower := hY.lowerProductDominates
    hLidskii hAndo hInterlace hw hInvA ht0 ht1
  have hlower' :
      LowerProductDominates
        (increasingEigenvalues hY.posDef.isHermitian) q := by
    unfold q a
    convert hlower using 1
    funext i
    congr 1
    funext j
    simpa [increasingEigenvalues, Function.comp_def] using
      (Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_inv (hA j) i.rev).symm
  have hy : ∀ i, 0 < increasingEigenvalues hY.posDef.isHermitian i :=
    fun i ↦ Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hY.posDef i.rev
  have ha : ∀ j i, 0 < a j i :=
    fun j i ↦ Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos (hA j) i
  have hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i := fun i ↦
    powerCoordinate_pos hw (fun j ↦ inv_pos.mpr (ha j i))
  have hy_mono : Monotone (increasingEigenvalues hY.posDef.isHermitian) :=
    increasingEigenvalues_monotone hY.posDef.isHermitian
  have hq_mono : Monotone q := by
    intro i l hil
    apply powerCoordinate_mono (fun j ↦ (hw j).le)
      (fun j ↦ (inv_pos.mpr (ha j i)).le) _ ht0
    intro j
    exact (inv_le_inv₀ (ha j i) (ha j l)).2
      (decreasingEigenvalues_antitone (hA j).isHermitian hil)
  have hscalar := inv_weakLogMajorized_of_lowerProductDominates
    hy hq hy_mono hq_mono hlower'
  have hleft :
      (fun i ↦ (increasingEigenvalues hY.posDef.isHermitian i)⁻¹) =
        decreasingEigenvalues hY.posDef.inv.isHermitian := by
    funext i
    rw [Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_inv hY.posDef]
    rfl
  have hright :
      (fun i ↦ (q i)⁻¹) =
        fun i ↦ powerCoordinate w
          (fun j ↦ decreasingEigenvalues (hA j).isHermitian i) (-t) := by
    funext i
    exact inv_powerCoordinate_invs hw (fun j ↦ ha j i)
  simpa [hleft, hright] using hscalar

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.IsSuper.norm
statement:
theorem IsSuper.norm
    {n m : ℕ} [NeZero n] {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {w : Fin m → ℝ} {A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜}
    {t : ℝ} {X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hX : IsSuper w A t X) :
    ((∑ j, w j •
      (X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * A j * X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) ^ t) ≤
        (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜)) ∧
      ((∑ j, w j * RCLike.re (Matrix.trace
        ((X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * A j * X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) ^ t))) ≤
          (n : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  have hS : S.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hX.posDef _
  have hSstar : S.conjTranspose = S := hS.isHermitian.eq
  have hcongr :
      S * positivePowerMeanMap w A t X * S ≤ S * X * S := by
    change (S * X * S - S * positivePowerMeanMap w A t X * S).PosSemidef
    have hdiff : (X - positivePowerMeanMap w A t X).PosSemidef := hX.2
    simpa only [hSstar, mul_sub, sub_mul] using
      hdiff.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same S
  have hmatrix :
      (∑ j, w j •
        (X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * A j * X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) ^ t) ≤
          (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) := by
    calc
      (∑ j, w j •
        (X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * A j * X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) ^ t) =
          S * positivePowerMeanMap w A t X * S :=
            (normalize_positivePowerMeanMap w A t hX.posDef).symm
      _ ≤ S * X * S := hcongr
      _ = 1 := Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_conjugate_self hX.posDef
  refine ⟨hmatrix, ?_⟩
  have htrace :=
    (Matrix.tracePositiveLinearMap (Fin n) ℝ 𝕜).monotone hmatrix
  have hre := RCLike.re_le_re htrace
  simpa [RCLike.smul_re] using hre

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.Matrix.PosDef.re_trace_rpow_eq_sum_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem Matrix.PosDef.re_trace_rpow_eq_sum_eigenvalues
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hD : D.PosDef) (t : ℝ) :
    RCLike.re (Matrix.trace (D ^ t)) =
      ∑ i, (decreasingEigenvalues hD.isHermitian i) ^ t
proof:
:= by
  calc
    RCLike.re (Matrix.trace (D ^ t)) =
        ∑ i, (hD.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) ^ t := by
      rw [CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hD.posSemidef.nonneg, hD.isHermitian.cfc_eq]
      simp [Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc, -Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply]
    _ = ∑ i, (decreasingEigenvalues hD.isHermitian i) ^ t :=
      (sum_comp_decreasingEigenvalues_eq_eigenvalues hD.isHermitian
        (fun x ↦ x ^ t)).symm
