    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {Y B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hY : Y.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) :
    (relativeMatrix Y B).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  let S : Matrix n n 𝕜 := Y ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  have hS : S.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hY _
  have hSstar : S.conjTranspose = S := hS.isHermitian.eq
  simpa only [relativeMatrix, show Y ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) = S from rfl, hSstar] using
    hB.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hS.isUnit)

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.Lidskii.trace
statement:
theorem Lidskii.trace
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] (hL : Lidskii 𝕜) :
    LidskiiTrace 𝕜
proof:
:= by
  intro n _ B Y hB hY t ht
  let D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := relativeMatrix Y B
  have hD : D.PosDef := relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB
  have hb : ∀ i, 0 < decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian i :=
    Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hB
  have hy : ∀ i, 0 < decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i :=
    Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hY
  have hd : ∀ l, 0 < decreasingEigenvalues hD.isHermitian l :=
    Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hD
  have hKaramata := (hL n B Y hB hY).sum_exp_le_sum_exp ht
  calc
    (∑ i, (decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian i /
        decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i) ^ t) =
        ∑ i, Real.exp (t *
          (Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hB.isHermitian i) -
            Real.log (decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian i))) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (div_pos (hb i) (hy i)),
        Real.log_div (hb i).ne' (hy i).ne']
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ ∑ i, Real.exp (t * Real.log
        (decreasingEigenvalues hD.isHermitian i)) := by
      simpa [D] using hKaramata
    _ = ∑ i, (decreasingEigenvalues hD.isHermitian i) ^ t := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (hd i)]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ = RCLike.re (Matrix.trace (D ^ t)) :=
      (Matrix.PosDef.re_trace_rpow_eq_sum_eigenvalues hD t).symm
    _ = RCLike.re (Matrix.trace
        ((Y ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * B * Y ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) ^ t)) := rfl

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.IsSuper.powerCoordinateProd_le_det
statement:
theorem IsSuper.powerCoordinateProd_le_det
    {n m : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero m]
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {w : Fin m → ℝ} {A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜}
    {t : ℝ} {X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hX : IsSuper w A t X)
    (hL : Lidskii 𝕜)
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (hA : ∀ j, (A j).PosDef)
    (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∏ i, powerCoordinate w
      (fun j ↦ decreasingEigenvalues (hA j).isHermitian i) t) ≤ RCLike.re X.det
proof:
:= by
  let y : Fin n → ℝ := decreasingEigenvalues hX.posDef.isHermitian
  let b : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ :=
    fun j ↦ decreasingEigenvalues (hA j).isHermitian
  let q : Fin n → ℝ := fun i ↦ powerCoordinate w (fun j ↦ b j i) t
  have hy : ∀ i, 0 < y i :=
    Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hX.posDef
  have hb : ∀ j i, 0 < b j i :=
    fun j ↦ Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos (hA j)
  have hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i := fun i ↦ powerCoordinate_pos hw (fun j ↦ hb j i)
  have hnorm :
      (∑ j, w j * RCLike.re (Matrix.trace
        ((X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * A j * X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) ^ t))) ≤
          (n : ℝ) := hX.norm.2
  have hper : ∀ j,
      (∑ i, (b j i / y i) ^ t) ≤
        RCLike.re (Matrix.trace
          ((X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * A j * X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) ^ t)) := by
    intro j
    simpa [b, y] using hL.trace n (A j) X (hA j) hX.posDef t ht
  have haggregate :
      (∑ i, ∑ j, w j * (b j i / y i) ^ t) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (∑ i, ∑ j, w j * (b j i / y i) ^ t) =
          ∑ j, w j * ∑ i, (b j i / y i) ^ t := by
            simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      _ ≤ ∑ j, w j * RCLike.re (Matrix.trace
          ((X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * A j * X ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) ^ t)) := by
            exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hper j) (hw j).le
      _ ≤ (n : ℝ) := hnorm
  have htrace : ∑ i, (q i / y i) ^ t ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
    calc
      ∑ i, (q i / y i) ^ t =
          ∑ i, ∑ j, w j * (b j i / y i) ^ t := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i _
            exact powerCoordinate_div_rpow hw (fun j ↦ hb j i) (hy i) ht
      _ ≤ (n : ℝ) := haggregate
  change (∏ i, q i) ≤ RCLike.re X.det
  exact det_ge_prod_of_normalized_trace_bound hX.posDef hq ht htrace

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.inverse_compress_le
statement:
theorem inverse_compress_le
    {V : Matrix n k ℂ} (hV : MatrixIsometry V)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    (compress V A)⁻¹ ≤ compress V A⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hshort : shorted V A ≤ compress V A := by
    have hfeasible := (shorted_variational hV hA).1
    have hlift : V * shorted V A * V.conjTranspose ≤ A := by
      change (A - V * shorted V A * V.conjTranspose).PosSemidef
      exact hfeasible
    have hcompressed := compress_mono V hlift
    have hcompLift :
        compress V (V * shorted V A * V.conjTranspose) = shorted V A := by
      calc
        compress V (V * shorted V A * V.conjTranspose) =
            (V.conjTranspose * V) * shorted V A *
              (V.conjTranspose * V) := by
          simp only [compress, Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = shorted V A := by rw [hV, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [hcompLift] at hcompressed
    exact hcompressed
  have hshortPos : (shorted V A).PosDef := shorted_posDef hV hA
  have hcompPos : (compress V A).PosDef := compress_posDef hV hA
  have hcompInvPos : (compress V A⁻¹).PosDef := compress_posDef hV hA.inv
  letI : Invertible (shorted V A) := hshortPos.isUnit.invertible
  letI : Invertible (compress V A) := hcompPos.isUnit.invertible
  letI : Invertible (compress V A⁻¹) := hcompInvPos.isUnit.invertible
  have hinv := CStarAlgebra.ringInverse_le_ringInverse
    hshort hshortPos.isStrictlyPositive
  simpa [shorted, Ring.inverse_of_isUnit hshortPos.isUnit,
    Ring.inverse_of_isUnit hcompPos.isUnit,
    Matrix.inv_inv_of_invertible] using hinv

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.powerMeanMap_order_contraction
statement:
theorem powerMeanMap_order_contraction
    (w : m → ℝ) (A : m → Matrix n n ℂ) (t : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (hA : ∀ j, (A j).PosDef)
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1)
    (X Y : ThompsonPD n) :
    (powerMeanMap w A t hw hA Y).val ≤
      Real.exp ((1 - t) * tdist X Y) •
        (powerMeanMap w A t hw hA X).val
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := Real.exp (tdist X Y)
  have hc : 0 < c := Real.exp_pos _
  have hYX : Y.val ≤ c • X.val := order_le_exp_tdist X Y
  rw [powerMeanMap_val, powerMeanMap_val, positivePowerMeanMap,
    positivePowerMeanMap]
  calc
    ∑ j, w j • weightedGeometricMean Y.val (A j) t ≤
        ∑ j, w j • weightedGeometricMean (c • X.val) (A j) t := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      exact smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left
        (weightedGeometricMean_mono_left Y.posDef
          (X.posDef.smul hc) (hA j) ht0 ht1 hYX)
        (hw j).le
    _ = ∑ j, w j •
        (c ^ (1 - t) • weightedGeometricMean X.val (A j) t) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [weightedGeometricMean_smul_left X.posDef (hA j) hc ht0 ht1]
    _ = c ^ (1 - t) •
        ∑ j, w j • weightedGeometricMean X.val (A j) t := by
      rw [Finset.smul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      simp only [smul_smul]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ = Real.exp ((1 - t) * tdist X Y) •
        ∑ j, w j • weightedGeometricMean X.val (A j) t := by
      congr 1
      rw [← Real.exp_mul]
      congr 1
      ring

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.powerMeanMap_dist_le
statement:
theorem powerMeanMap_dist_le
    (w : m → ℝ) (A : m → Matrix n n ℂ) (t : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (hA : ∀ j, (A j).PosDef)
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1)
    (X Y : ThompsonPD n) :
    dist (powerMeanMap w A t hw hA X) (powerMeanMap w A t hw hA Y) ≤
      (1 - t) * dist X Y
proof:
:= by
  let F := powerMeanMap w A t hw hA
  have hYX : (F Y).val ≤ Real.exp ((1 - t) * tdist X Y) • (F X).val :=
    powerMeanMap_order_contraction w A t hw hA ht0 ht1 X Y
  have hXY : (F X).val ≤ Real.exp ((1 - t) * tdist X Y) • (F Y).val := by
    simpa only [tdist_comm] using
      powerMeanMap_order_contraction w A t hw hA ht0 ht1 Y X
  have htd := tdist_le_of_order_exp (F X) (F Y) hYX hXY
  simpa only [dist_eq_tdist] using htd

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.powerMeanMap_contracting
statement:
theorem powerMeanMap_contracting
    (w : m → ℝ) (A : m → Matrix n n ℂ) (t : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (hA : ∀ j, (A j).PosDef)
    (ht0 : 0 < t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    ContractingWith ⟨1 - t, sub_nonneg.mpr ht1⟩
      (powerMeanMap w A t hw hA)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change 1 - t < (1 : ℝ)
    linarith
  · apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro X Y
    change dist (powerMeanMap w A t hw hA X)
      (powerMeanMap w A t hw hA Y) ≤ (1 - t) * dist X Y
    exact powerMeanMap_dist_le w A t hw hA ht0.le ht1 X Y

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.fixedPoint_from_mathlib
statement: theorem fixedPoint_from_mathlib : FixedPoint ℂ
proof:
:= by
  intro n m _ _ ω A t hA ht0 ht1
  let F := ThompsonPD.powerMeanMap ω.value A t ω.positive hA
  let K : ℝ≥0 := ⟨1 - t, sub_nonneg.mpr ht1⟩
  have hcontract : ContractingWith K F :=
    ThompsonPD.powerMeanMap_contracting ω.value A t ω.positive hA ht0 ht1
  let X₀ : ThompsonPD (Fin n) := ⟨1, Matrix.PosDef.one⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hPfixed, _⟩ :=
    hcontract.exists_fixedPoint X₀ (edist_ne_top X₀ (F X₀))
  have hPmean : IsMean ω.value A t P.val := by
    refine ⟨P.posDef, ?_⟩
    exact congrArg ThompsonPD.val hPfixed.symm
  refine ⟨P.val, hPmean, ?_⟩
  intro X hXmean
  let Q : ThompsonPD (Fin n) := ⟨X, hXmean.posDef⟩
  have hQfixed : IsFixedPt F Q := by
    apply ThompsonPD.ext
    exact hXmean.fixedPoint.symm
  have hPQ : P = Q := hcontract.fixedPoint_unique' hPfixed hQfixed
  exact (congrArg ThompsonPD.val hPQ).symm

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.norm_le_of_order_interval
statement:
theorem norm_le_of_order_interval
    {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : IsSelfAdjoint X) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hlower : -(r • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) ≤ X)
    (hupper : X ≤ r • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) :
    ‖X‖ ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  have hscalar :
      algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) r = r • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  have hupper' : X ≤ algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) r := by
    simpa only [hscalar] using hupper
  have hlower' : algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) (-r) ≤ X := by
    rw [map_neg, hscalar]
    simpa only [neg_smul] using hlower
  have hsU := (le_algebraMap_iff_spectrum_le hX).mp hupper'
  have hsL := (algebraMap_le_iff_le_spectrum hX).mp hlower'
  rw [← cfc_id' ℝ X hX]
  apply norm_cfc_le hr
  intro x hx
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by simpa using hsL x hx, hsU x hx⟩

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.ratio_le_iff
statement:
theorem ratio_le_iff (A B : ThompsonPD n) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ratio A B ≤ r ↔ B.val ≤ r • A.val
proof:
:= by
  let S : Matrix n n ℂ := A.val ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  let R : Matrix n n ℂ := A.val ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hS : S.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow A.posDef _
  have hR : R.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow A.posDef _
  have hrel : relative A B = S * B.val * S := rfl
  have hscalar :
      algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) r = r • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  rw [ratio, CStarAlgebra.norm_le_iff_le_algebraMap
    (relative A B) hr (relative_posDef A B).posSemidef.nonneg]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hc := compress_mono R h
    rw [hscalar] at hc
    have hRS : R * S = 1 := Matrix.PosDef.half_mul_invHalf A.posDef
    have hSR : S * R = 1 := Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_mul_half A.posDef
    have hRR : R * R = A.val := Matrix.PosDef.sqrt_mul_sqrt A.posDef
    have hleft : compress R (relative A B) = B.val := by
      rw [compress, hR.isHermitian.eq, relative]
      calc
        R * (S * B.val * S) * R = (R * S) * B.val * (S * R) := by
          noncomm_ring
        _ = B.val := by rw [hRS, hSR, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
    have hright : compress R (r • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) = r • A.val := by
      rw [compress, hR.isHermitian.eq]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hRR]
    simpa only [hleft, hright] using hc
  · intro h
    have hc := compress_mono S h
    rw [hscalar]
    have hSA : S * A.val * S = 1 :=
      Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_conjugate_self A.posDef
    simpa only [relative, compress, hS.isHermitian.eq, Matrix.mul_smul,
      Matrix.smul_mul, hSA, Matrix.mul_one] using hc

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.relative_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relative_self (A : ThompsonPD n) : relative A A = 1
proof:
:=
  Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_conjugate_self A.posDef

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.ratio_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ratio_self (A : ThompsonPD n) : ratio A A = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [ratio]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.ratio_triangle
statement:
theorem ratio_triangle (A B C : ThompsonPD n) :
    ratio A C ≤ ratio A B * ratio B C
proof:
:= by
  have hAB : B.val ≤ ratio A B • A.val :=
    (ratio_le_iff A B (ratio_nonneg A B)).mp le_rfl
  have hBC : C.val ≤ ratio B C • B.val :=
    (ratio_le_iff B C (ratio_nonneg B C)).mp le_rfl
  apply (ratio_le_iff A C (mul_nonneg (ratio_nonneg A B)
    (ratio_nonneg B C))).mpr
  calc
    C.val ≤ ratio B C • B.val := hBC
    _ ≤ ratio B C • (ratio A B • A.val) := by
      exact smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hAB (ratio_nonneg B C)
    _ = (ratio A B * ratio B C) • A.val := by
      rw [smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.tdist_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tdist_self (A : ThompsonPD n) : tdist A A = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [tdist]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.tdist_comm
statement: theorem tdist_comm (A B : ThompsonPD n) : tdist A B = tdist B A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tdist]
  exact max_comm _ _

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.log_ratio_le_tdist
statement:
theorem log_ratio_le_tdist (A B : ThompsonPD n) :
    Real.log (ratio A B) ≤ tdist A B
proof:
:=
  le_max_left _ _

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.ratio_le_exp_tdist
statement:
theorem ratio_le_exp_tdist (A B : ThompsonPD n) :
    ratio A B ≤ Real.exp (tdist A B)
proof:
:=
  (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (ratio_pos A B)).mp (log_ratio_le_tdist A B)

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.order_le_exp_tdist
statement:
theorem order_le_exp_tdist (A B : ThompsonPD n) :
    B.val ≤ Real.exp (tdist A B) • A.val
proof:
:=
  (ratio_le_iff A B (Real.exp_pos _).le).mp (ratio_le_exp_tdist A B)

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.order_le_exp_of_dist_lt
statement:
theorem order_le_exp_of_dist_lt
    (A B : ThompsonPD n) {e : ℝ} (h : tdist A B < e) :
    B.val ≤ Real.exp e • A.val
proof:
:= by
  calc
    B.val ≤ Real.exp (tdist A B) • A.val := order_le_exp_tdist A B
    _ ≤ Real.exp e • A.val := by
      exact smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right
        (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h.le) A.posDef.posSemidef.nonneg

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.tdist_le_of_order_exp
statement:
theorem tdist_le_of_order_exp
    (A B : ThompsonPD n) {e : ℝ}
    (hBA : B.val ≤ Real.exp e • A.val)
    (hAB : A.val ≤ Real.exp e • B.val) :
    tdist A B ≤ e
proof:
:= by
  have hrAB : ratio A B ≤ Real.exp e :=
    (ratio_le_iff A B (Real.exp_pos e).le).mpr hBA
  have hrBA : ratio B A ≤ Real.exp e :=
    (ratio_le_iff B A (Real.exp_pos e).le).mpr hAB
  apply max_le
  · exact (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (ratio_pos A B)).mpr hrAB
  · exact (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (ratio_pos B A)).mpr hrBA

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.norm_sub_le_of_dist_lt_of_upper
statement:
theorem norm_sub_le_of_dist_lt_of_upper
    (A B : ThompsonPD n) {e M : ℝ} (he : 0 ≤ e) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hA : A.val ≤ M • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hB : B.val ≤ M • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hd : tdist A B < e) :
    ‖B.val - A.val‖ ≤ (Real.exp e - 1) * M
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := Real.exp e - 1
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := by
    dsimp [c]
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.one_le_exp he)
  have hBA : B.val ≤ Real.exp e • A.val :=
    order_le_exp_of_dist_lt A B hd
  have hAB : A.val ≤ Real.exp e • B.val :=
    order_le_exp_of_dist_lt B A (by simpa [tdist_comm] using hd)
  have hu : B.val - A.val ≤ (c * M) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    calc
      B.val - A.val ≤ Real.exp e • A.val - A.val :=
        sub_le_sub_right hBA A.val
      _ = c • A.val := by
        dsimp [c]
        module
      _ ≤ c • (M • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) :=
        smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hA hc
      _ = (c * M) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by rw [smul_smul]
  have hl : -((c * M) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) ≤ B.val - A.val := by
    have hdiff : A.val - B.val ≤ (c * M) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
      calc
        A.val - B.val ≤ Real.exp e • B.val - B.val :=
          sub_le_sub_right hAB B.val
        _ = c • B.val := by
          dsimp [c]
          module
        _ ≤ c • (M • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) :=
          smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hB hc
        _ = (c * M) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by rw [smul_smul]
    simpa only [neg_sub] using neg_le_neg hdiff
  exact norm_le_of_order_interval
    (B.posDef.isHermitian.sub A.posDef.isHermitian)
    (mul_nonneg hc hM) hl hu

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.tdist_triangle
statement:
theorem tdist_triangle (A B C : ThompsonPD n) :
    tdist A C ≤ tdist A B + tdist B C
proof:
:= by
  have hforward : Real.log (ratio A C) ≤
      tdist A B + tdist B C := by
    calc
      Real.log (ratio A C) ≤
          Real.log (ratio A B * ratio B C) :=
        Real.log_le_log (ratio_pos A C)
          (ratio_triangle A B C)
      _ = Real.log (ratio A B) + Real.log (ratio B C) := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (ratio_pos A B).ne' (ratio_pos B C).ne']
      _ ≤ tdist A B + tdist B C :=
        add_le_add (log_ratio_le_tdist A B) (log_ratio_le_tdist B C)
  have hreverse : Real.log (ratio C A) ≤
      tdist A B + tdist B C := by
    calc
      Real.log (ratio C A) ≤
          Real.log (ratio C B * ratio B A) :=
        Real.log_le_log (ratio_pos C A)
          (ratio_triangle C B A)
      _ = Real.log (ratio C B) + Real.log (ratio B A) := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (ratio_pos C B).ne' (ratio_pos B A).ne']
      _ ≤ tdist B C + tdist A B := by
        have hCB := log_ratio_le_tdist C B
        have hBA := log_ratio_le_tdist B A
        rw [tdist_comm C B] at hCB
        rw [tdist_comm B A] at hBA
        exact add_le_add hCB hBA
      _ = tdist A B + tdist B C := add_comm _ _
  exact max_le hforward hreverse

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.eq_of_tdist_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_of_tdist_eq_zero {A B : ThompsonPD n} (h : tdist A B = 0) :
    A = B
proof:
:= by
  have hABlog : Real.log (ratio A B) ≤ 0 := by
    rw [← h]
    exact log_ratio_le_tdist A B
  have hBAlog : Real.log (ratio B A) ≤ 0 := by
    rw [← h]
    simpa [tdist_comm] using log_ratio_le_tdist B A
  have hABratio : ratio A B ≤ 1 :=
    (Real.log_nonpos_iff (ratio_nonneg A B)).mp hABlog
  have hBAratio : ratio B A ≤ 1 :=
    (Real.log_nonpos_iff (ratio_nonneg B A)).mp hBAlog
  have hBA : B.val ≤ A.val := by
    simpa using (ratio_le_iff A B zero_le_one).mp hABratio
  have hAB : A.val ≤ B.val := by
    simpa using (ratio_le_iff B A zero_le_one).mp hBAratio
  exact ext (le_antisymm hAB hBA)

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.dist_eq_tdist
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dist_eq_tdist (A B : ThompsonPD n) : dist A B = tdist A B
proof: := rfl

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.cauchySeq_val
statement:
theorem cauchySeq_val {u : ℕ → ThompsonPD n} (hu : CauchySeq u) :
    CauchySeq (fun k ↦ (u k).val)
proof:
:= by
  have huc := Metric.cauchySeq_iff.mp hu
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := huc 1 zero_lt_one
  let M : ℝ := Real.exp 1 * ‖(u N₀).val‖
  have hanchorNorm : 0 < ‖(u N₀).val‖ := by
    rw [norm_pos_iff]
    exact (u N₀).posDef.isUnit.ne_zero
  have hMpos : 0 < M := mul_pos (Real.exp_pos 1) hanchorNorm
  have hupper : ∀ k ≥ N₀,
      (u k).val ≤ M • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    intro k hk
    have hdist : dist (u N₀) (u k) < 1 := by
      simpa [dist_comm] using hN₀ k hk N₀ le_rfl
    have hord := order_le_exp_of_dist_lt (u N₀) (u k)
      (by simpa [dist_eq_tdist] using hdist)
    have hanchor_le :
        (u N₀).val ≤ ‖(u N₀).val‖ • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
      simpa [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
        IsSelfAdjoint.le_algebraMap_norm_self (u N₀).posDef.isHermitian
    calc
      (u k).val ≤ Real.exp 1 • (u N₀).val := hord
      _ ≤ Real.exp 1 •
          (‖(u N₀).val‖ • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) := by
        exact smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left
          hanchor_le (Real.exp_pos 1).le
      _ = M • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
        rw [smul_smul]
  rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
  intro e he
  let d : ℝ := Real.log (1 + e / (2 * M))
  have hfrac : 0 < e / (2 * M) := div_pos he (mul_pos two_pos hMpos)
  have hone : 0 < 1 + e / (2 * M) := by linarith
  have hd : 0 < d := by
    exact Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := huc d hd
  refine ⟨max N₀ N₁, ?_⟩
  intro p hp q hq
  have hp₀ : N₀ ≤ p := (le_max_left _ _).trans hp
  have hq₀ : N₀ ≤ q := (le_max_left _ _).trans hq
  have hp₁ : N₁ ≤ p := (le_max_right _ _).trans hp
  have hq₁ : N₁ ≤ q := (le_max_right _ _).trans hq
  have hdist : dist (u p) (u q) < d := hN₁ p hp₁ q hq₁
  have hnorm := norm_sub_le_of_dist_lt_of_upper (u q) (u p)
    hd.le hMpos.le (hupper q hq₀) (hupper p hp₀)
      (by simpa [dist_eq_tdist, tdist_comm] using hdist)
  have hexp : Real.exp d = 1 + e / (2 * M) := by
    rw [show d = Real.log (1 + e / (2 * M)) from rfl, Real.exp_log hone]
  have hcalc : (Real.exp d - 1) * M = e / 2 := by
    rw [hexp]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  calc
    ‖(u p).val - (u q).val‖ ≤ (Real.exp d - 1) * M := hnorm
    _ = e / 2 := hcalc
    _ < e := by linarith

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.exists_uniform_lower
proof:
:= by
  have huc := Metric.cauchySeq_iff.mp hu
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := huc 1 zero_lt_one
  obtain ⟨a, ha, ha_le⟩ : ∃ a > 0,
      algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) a ≤ (u N).val := by
    exact (CFC.exists_pos_algebraMap_le_iff (u N).posDef.isHermitian).mpr
      (fun x hx ↦ (u N).posDef.isStrictlyPositive.spectrum_pos hx)
  have ha_le' : a • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ (u N).val := by
    simpa [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using ha_le
  let mu : ℝ := a / Real.exp 1
  have hmu : 0 < mu := div_pos ha (Real.exp_pos 1)
  have hlower_tail : ∀ k ≥ N,
      mu • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ (u k).val := by
    intro k hk
    have hdist : dist (u k) (u N) < 1 := hN k hk N le_rfl
    have hord : (u N).val ≤ Real.exp 1 • (u k).val :=
      order_le_exp_of_dist_lt (u k) (u N)
        (by simpa [dist_eq_tdist] using hdist)
    have heinv : 0 ≤ (Real.exp 1)⁻¹ :=
      inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.exp_pos 1).le
    calc
      mu • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) =
          (Real.exp 1)⁻¹ • (a • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) := by
        rw [smul_smul]
        dsimp [mu]
        field_simp
      _ ≤ (Real.exp 1)⁻¹ • (u N).val :=
        smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left ha_le' heinv
      _ ≤ (Real.exp 1)⁻¹ • (Real.exp 1 • (u k).val) :=
        smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hord heinv
      _ = (u k).val := by
        rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (Real.exp_pos 1).ne', one_smul]
  have hlower : mu • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ L := by
    apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto tendsto_const_nhds hL
    filter_upwards [eventually_atTop.2 ⟨N, fun k hk ↦ hk⟩] with k hk
    exact hlower_tail k hk
  refine ⟨mu, hmu, hlower, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_atTop.2 ⟨N, fun k hk ↦ hk⟩] with k hk
  exact hlower_tail k hk

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.exists_posDef_norm_limit
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete (cauchySeq_val hu)
  obtain ⟨mu, hmu, hlower, _⟩ := exists_uniform_lower hu hL
  have hmuPD : (mu • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)).PosDef :=
    Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hmu
  have hLpsd : L.PosSemidef := by
    exact Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
      (hmuPD.posSemidef.nonneg.trans hlower)
  have hLunit : IsUnit L :=
    CStarAlgebra.isUnit_of_le (mu • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) hlower
      hmuPD.isStrictlyPositive
  exact ⟨L, hLpsd.posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr hLunit, hL⟩

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ThompsonPD.tendsto_of_norm_tendsto_of_lower
statement:
theorem tendsto_of_norm_tendsto_of_lower
    {u : ℕ → ThompsonPD n} {L : Matrix n n ℂ} (hLPD : L.PosDef)
    (hL : Tendsto (fun k ↦ (u k).val) atTop (nhds L))
    {mu : ℝ} (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hlowerL : mu • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ L)
    (hlowerU : ∀ᶠ k in atTop,
      mu • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ (u k).val) :
    Tendsto u atTop (nhds (⟨L, hLPD⟩ : ThompsonPD n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
  intro e he
  let s : ℝ := e / 2
  let c : ℝ := Real.exp s - 1
  have hs : 0 < s := half_pos he
  have hc : 0 < c := sub_pos.mpr (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr hs)
  have hcmu : 0 < c * mu := mul_pos hc hmu
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hL (c * mu) hcmu
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 hlowerU
  refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  have hk₁ : N₁ ≤ k := (le_max_left _ _).trans hk
  have hk₂ : N₂ ≤ k := (le_max_right _ _).trans hk
  have hnormlt : ‖(u k).val - L‖ < c * mu := by
    simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hN₁ k hk₁
  have hnormle : ‖(u k).val - L‖ ≤ c * mu := hnormlt.le
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := hc.le
  have hupperDiff : (u k).val - L ≤ c • L := by
    calc
      (u k).val - L ≤
          ‖(u k).val - L‖ • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
        simpa [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
          IsSelfAdjoint.le_algebraMap_norm_self
            ((u k).posDef.isHermitian.sub hLPD.isHermitian)
      _ ≤ (c * mu) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
        exact smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right hnormle Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg
      _ = c • (mu • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) := by rw [smul_smul]
      _ ≤ c • L := smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hlowerL hc0
  have hupperDiff' : L - (u k).val ≤ c • (u k).val := by
    calc
      L - (u k).val ≤
          ‖L - (u k).val‖ • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
        simpa [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
          IsSelfAdjoint.le_algebraMap_norm_self
            (hLPD.isHermitian.sub (u k).posDef.isHermitian)
      _ = ‖(u k).val - L‖ • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
        rw [norm_sub_rev]
      _ ≤ (c * mu) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
        exact smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right hnormle Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg
      _ = c • (mu • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) := by rw [smul_smul]
      _ ≤ c • (u k).val :=
        smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left (hN₂ k hk₂) hc0
  have hUL : (u k).val ≤ Real.exp s • L := by
    calc
      (u k).val = ((u k).val - L) + L := by module
      _ ≤ c • L + L := by
        simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hupperDiff L
      _ = Real.exp s • L := by
        dsimp [c]
        module
  have hLU : L ≤ Real.exp s • (u k).val := by
    calc
      L = (L - (u k).val) + (u k).val := by module
      _ ≤ c • (u k).val + (u k).val :=
        by simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hupperDiff' (u k).val
      _ = Real.exp s • (u k).val := by
        dsimp [c]
        module
  have htd : tdist (u k) ⟨L, hLPD⟩ ≤ s :=
    tdist_le_of_order_exp (u k) ⟨L, hLPD⟩ hLU hUL
  calc
    dist (u k) ⟨L, hLPD⟩ = tdist (u k) ⟨L, hLPD⟩ := rfl
    _ ≤ s := htd
    _ < e := by dsimp [s]; linarith

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.Matrix.PosDef.rpow_smul
statement:
theorem Matrix.PosDef.rpow_smul
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) {c t : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (c • A) ^ t = c ^ t • A ^ t
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ A, 0 < c * x := by
    intro x hx
    exact mul_pos hc (hA.isStrictlyPositive.spectrum_pos hx)
  have hrpow_cont : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ t) (spectrum ℝ A) :=
    ContinuousOn.rpow_const (by fun_prop) (by
      intro x hx
      exact Or.inl (ne_of_gt (hA.isStrictlyPositive.spectrum_pos hx)))
  calc
    (c • A) ^ t = (cfc (fun x : ℝ ↦ c * x) A) ^ t := by
      rw [cfc_const_mul_id c A hA.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint]
    _ = cfc (fun x : ℝ ↦ (c * x) ^ t) A :=
      CFC.cfc_rpow hfun
    _ = cfc (fun x : ℝ ↦ c ^ t * x ^ t) A := by
      apply cfc_congr
      intro x hx
      change (c * x) ^ t = c ^ t * x ^ t
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (le_of_lt hc)
        (le_of_lt (hA.isStrictlyPositive.spectrum_pos hx))]
    _ = c ^ t • cfc (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ t) A := by
      exact cfc_const_mul (R := ℝ) (A := Matrix n n ℂ) (c ^ t)
        (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ t) A hrpow_cont
    _ = c ^ t • A ^ t := by
      rw [CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hA.posSemidef.nonneg]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.weightedGeometricMean_mono_right
statement:
theorem weightedGeometricMean_mono_right
    {A B C : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hC : C.PosDef)
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) (hBC : B ≤ C) :
    weightedGeometricMean A B t ≤ weightedGeometricMean A C t
proof:
:= by
  let S : Matrix n n ℂ := A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  let R : Matrix n n ℂ := A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hS : S.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hA _
  have hR : R.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hA _
  have hSB : (S * B * S).PosDef := by
    simpa only [hS.isHermitian.eq] using hB.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
      (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hS.isUnit)
  have hSC : (S * C * S).PosDef := by
    simpa only [hS.isHermitian.eq] using hC.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
      (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hS.isUnit)
  have hinner : S * B * S ≤ S * C * S := by
    simpa only [compress, hS.isHermitian.eq] using compress_mono S hBC
  have hpow : (S * B * S) ^ t ≤ (S * C * S) ^ t :=
    CFC.rpow_le_rpow ⟨ht0, ht1⟩ hinner
  have hout := compress_mono R hpow
  simpa only [weightedGeometricMean, S, R, compress, hR.isHermitian.eq]
    using hout

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.weightedGeometricMean_compress_le_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem weightedGeometricMean_compress_le_of_isUnit
    {V A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hV : IsUnit V)
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef)
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    compress V (weightedGeometricMean A B t) ≤
      weightedGeometricMean (compress V A) (compress V B) t
proof:
:= by
  let C : Matrix n n ℂ := compress V A
  let R : Matrix n n ℂ := A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let Q : Matrix n n ℂ := A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  let T : Matrix n n ℂ := C ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let S : Matrix n n ℂ := C ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  let X : Matrix n n ℂ := Q * B * Q
  let W : Matrix n n ℂ := R * V * S
  have hC : C.PosDef := by
    exact hA.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
      (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hV)
  have hR : R.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hA _
  have hQ : Q.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hA _
  have hT : T.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hC _
  have hS : S.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hC _
  have hX : X.PosDef := by
    have hQstar : Q.conjTranspose = Q := hQ.isHermitian.eq
    simpa only [X, hQstar] using hB.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
      (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hQ.isUnit)
  have hRR : R * R = A := by
    simpa only [R] using Matrix.PosDef.sqrt_mul_sqrt hA
  have hW : MatrixIsometry W := by
    change W.conjTranspose * W = 1
    rw [show W.conjTranspose = S * V.conjTranspose * R by
      simp only [W, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hR.isHermitian.eq,
        hS.isHermitian.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc]]
    calc
      (S * V.conjTranspose * R) * W =
          S * (V.conjTranspose * ((R * R) * V)) * S := by
        simp only [W, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = S * (V.conjTranspose * (A * V)) * S := by rw [hRR]
      _ = S * C * S := by simp only [C, compress, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_conjugate_self hC
  have hRXR : R * X * R = B := by
    calc
      R * X * R = (R * Q) * B * (Q * R) := by
        simp only [X]
        noncomm_ring
      _ = B := by
        rw [show R * Q = 1 from Matrix.PosDef.half_mul_invHalf hA,
          show Q * R = 1 from Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_mul_half hA,
          Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hcompressWX : compress W X = S * compress V B * S := by
    calc
      compress W X =
          S * (V.conjTranspose * ((R * X * R) * V)) * S := by
        simp only [compress, W, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
          hR.isHermitian.eq, hS.isHermitian.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = S * (V.conjTranspose * (B * V)) * S := by rw [hRXR]
      _ = S * compress V B * S := by simp only [compress, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hcompressWt : compress W (X ^ t) =
      S * compress V (weightedGeometricMean A B t) * S := by
    calc
      compress W (X ^ t) =
          S * (V.conjTranspose * ((R * X ^ t * R) * V)) * S := by
        simp only [compress, W, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
          hR.isHermitian.eq, hS.isHermitian.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = S * compress V (weightedGeometricMean A B t) * S := by
        simp only [weightedGeometricMean, R, Q, X, compress,
          Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hHansen := compress_rpow_le hW hX ht0 ht1
  rw [hcompressWt, hcompressWX] at hHansen
  have hconj := compress_mono T hHansen
  have hTS : T * S = 1 := Matrix.PosDef.half_mul_invHalf hC
  have hST : S * T = 1 := Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_mul_half hC
  have hcompressT (Z : Matrix n n ℂ) : compress T Z = T * Z * T := by
    rw [compress, hT.isHermitian.eq]
  have hundo (Z : Matrix n n ℂ) : compress T (S * Z * S) = Z := by
    rw [hcompressT]
    calc
      T * (S * Z * S) * T = (T * S) * Z * (S * T) := by
        noncomm_ring
      _ = Z := by rw [hTS, hST, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  calc
    compress V (weightedGeometricMean A B t) =
        compress T (S * compress V (weightedGeometricMean A B t) * S) := by
      exact (hundo _).symm
    _ ≤ compress T ((S * compress V B * S) ^ t) := hconj
    _ = weightedGeometricMean (compress V A) (compress V B) t := by
      rw [hcompressT]
      rfl

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.weightedGeometricMean_compress_eq
statement:
theorem weightedGeometricMean_compress_eq
    (V : (Matrix n n ℂ)ˣ) {A B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef)
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    compress (V : Matrix n n ℂ) (weightedGeometricMean A B t) =
      weightedGeometricMean (compress (V : Matrix n n ℂ) A)
        (compress (V : Matrix n n ℂ) B) t
proof:
:= by
  let C : Matrix n n ℂ := compress (V : Matrix n n ℂ) A
  let D : Matrix n n ℂ := compress (V : Matrix n n ℂ) B
  let W : (Matrix n n ℂ)ˣ := V⁻¹
  have hC : C.PosDef := hA.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
    (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit V.isUnit)
  have hD : D.PosDef := hB.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
    (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit V.isUnit)
  have hforward :
      compress (V : Matrix n n ℂ) (weightedGeometricMean A B t) ≤
        weightedGeometricMean C D t := by
    exact weightedGeometricMean_compress_le_of_isUnit V.isUnit hA hB ht0 ht1
  have hVW : (V : Matrix n n ℂ) * (W : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := by
    simp [W]
  have hWV : (W : Matrix n n ℂ) * (V : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := by
    simp [W]
  have hCA : compress (W : Matrix n n ℂ) C = A := by
    calc
      compress (W : Matrix n n ℂ) C =
          ((V : Matrix n n ℂ) * (W : Matrix n n ℂ)).conjTranspose *
            A * ((V : Matrix n n ℂ) * (W : Matrix n n ℂ)) := by
        simp only [C, compress, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
        noncomm_ring
      _ = A := by rw [hVW]; simp
  have hDB : compress (W : Matrix n n ℂ) D = B := by
    calc
      compress (W : Matrix n n ℂ) D =
          ((V : Matrix n n ℂ) * (W : Matrix n n ℂ)).conjTranspose *
            B * ((V : Matrix n n ℂ) * (W : Matrix n n ℂ)) := by
        simp only [D, compress, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
        noncomm_ring
      _ = B := by rw [hVW]; simp
  have hback :
      compress (W : Matrix n n ℂ) (weightedGeometricMean C D t) ≤
        weightedGeometricMean A B t := by
    simpa only [hCA, hDB] using
      weightedGeometricMean_compress_le_of_isUnit W.isUnit hC hD ht0 ht1
  have hback' := compress_mono (V : Matrix n n ℂ) hback
  have hundocomp (Z : Matrix n n ℂ) :
      compress (V : Matrix n n ℂ)
          (compress (W : Matrix n n ℂ) Z) = Z := by
    calc
      compress (V : Matrix n n ℂ) (compress (W : Matrix n n ℂ) Z) =
          ((W : Matrix n n ℂ) * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)).conjTranspose *
            Z * ((W : Matrix n n ℂ) * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)) := by
        simp only [compress, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
        noncomm_ring
      _ = Z := by rw [hWV]; simp
  apply le_antisymm hforward
  simpa only [hundocomp] using hback'

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.weightedGeometricMean_one_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightedGeometricMean_one_left (B : Matrix n n ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    weightedGeometricMean 1 B t = B ^ t
proof:
:= by
  simp [weightedGeometricMean]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.weightedGeometricMean_one_right
statement:
theorem weightedGeometricMean_one_right
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) (t : ℝ) :
    weightedGeometricMean A 1 t = A ^ (1 - t)
proof:
:= by
  have hQsq :
      A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) = A ^ (-1 : ℝ) := by
    rw [← CFC.rpow_add hA.isUnit]
    congr 1
    norm_num
  have hpow : (A ^ (-1 : ℝ)) ^ t = A ^ (-t) := by
    rw [CFC.rpow_rpow A (-1 : ℝ) t (by norm_num) hA.isStrictlyPositive]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [weightedGeometricMean]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_one, hQsq, hpow]
  calc
    A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * A ^ (-t) * A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) =
        A ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + (-t)) * A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      rw [CFC.rpow_add hA.isUnit]
    _ = A ^ (((1 / 2 : ℝ) + (-t)) + (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
      exact (CFC.rpow_add (a := A) (x := (1 / 2 : ℝ) + (-t))
        (y := (1 / 2 : ℝ)) hA.isUnit).symm
    _ = A ^ (1 - t) := by
      congr 1
      ring

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.weightedGeometricMean_symm
statement:
theorem weightedGeometricMean_symm
    {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef)
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    weightedGeometricMean A B t = weightedGeometricMean B A (1 - t)
proof:
:= by
  let R : Matrix n n ℂ := A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let Q : Matrix n n ℂ := A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  let C : Matrix n n ℂ := Q * B * Q
  have hR : R.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hA _
  have hQ : Q.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hA _
  have hC : C.PosDef := by
    simpa only [C, hQ.isHermitian.eq] using hB.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
      (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hQ.isUnit)
  let U : (Matrix n n ℂ)ˣ := hR.isUnit.unit
  have hU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = R := hR.isUnit.unit_spec
  have hcompOne : compress (U : Matrix n n ℂ) 1 = A := by
    rw [hU, compress, hR.isHermitian.eq, Matrix.mul_one]
    exact Matrix.PosDef.sqrt_mul_sqrt hA
  have hcompC : compress (U : Matrix n n ℂ) C = B := by
    rw [hU, compress, hR.isHermitian.eq]
    calc
      R * C * R = (R * Q) * B * (Q * R) := by
        simp only [C]
        noncomm_ring
      _ = B := by
        rw [show R * Q = 1 from Matrix.PosDef.half_mul_invHalf hA,
          show Q * R = 1 from Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_mul_half hA,
          Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  have ht'0 : 0 ≤ 1 - t := by linarith
  have ht'1 : 1 - t ≤ 1 := by linarith
  calc
    weightedGeometricMean A B t =
        compress (U : Matrix n n ℂ) (weightedGeometricMean 1 C t) := by
      rw [weightedGeometricMean_compress_eq U Matrix.PosDef.one hC ht0 ht1,
        hcompOne, hcompC]
    _ = compress (U : Matrix n n ℂ) (C ^ t) := by
      rw [weightedGeometricMean_one_left]
    _ = compress (U : Matrix n n ℂ)
        (weightedGeometricMean C 1 (1 - t)) := by
      rw [weightedGeometricMean_one_right hC]
      congr 2
      ring
    _ = weightedGeometricMean B A (1 - t) := by
      rw [weightedGeometricMean_compress_eq U hC Matrix.PosDef.one ht'0 ht'1,
        hcompC, hcompOne]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.weightedGeometricMean_mono_left
statement:
theorem weightedGeometricMean_mono_left
    {A B C : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hC : C.PosDef)
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    weightedGeometricMean A C t ≤ weightedGeometricMean B C t
proof:
:= by
  have ht'0 : 0 ≤ 1 - t := by linarith
  have ht'1 : 1 - t ≤ 1 := by linarith
  rw [weightedGeometricMean_symm hA hC ht0 ht1,
    weightedGeometricMean_symm hB hC ht0 ht1]
  exact weightedGeometricMean_mono_right hC hA hB ht'0 ht'1 hAB

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.weightedGeometricMean_smul_right
statement:
theorem weightedGeometricMean_smul_right
    {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef)
    {c t : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    weightedGeometricMean A (c • B) t =
      c ^ t • weightedGeometricMean A B t
proof:
:= by
  let S : Matrix n n ℂ := A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  have hS : S.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hA _
  have hinner : (S * B * S).PosDef := by
    simpa only [hS.isHermitian.eq] using hB.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
      (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hS.isUnit)
  rw [weightedGeometricMean, weightedGeometricMean]
  have hscale : S * (c • B) * S = c • (S * B * S) := by
    simp
  rw [hscale, Matrix.PosDef.rpow_smul hinner hc]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
  rfl

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.weightedGeometricMean_smul_left
statement:
theorem weightedGeometricMean_smul_left
    {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef)
    {c t : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    weightedGeometricMean (c • A) B t =
      c ^ (1 - t) • weightedGeometricMean A B t
proof:
:= by
  have hcA : (c • A).PosDef := hA.smul hc
  have ht'0 : 0 ≤ 1 - t := by linarith
  have ht'1 : 1 - t ≤ 1 := by linarith
  calc
    weightedGeometricMean (c • A) B t =
        weightedGeometricMean B (c • A) (1 - t) :=
      weightedGeometricMean_symm hcA hB ht0 ht1
    _ = c ^ (1 - t) • weightedGeometricMean B A (1 - t) :=
      weightedGeometricMean_smul_right hB hA hc
    _ = c ^ (1 - t) • weightedGeometricMean A B t := by
      rw [weightedGeometricMean_symm hA hB ht0 ht1]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.matrixIsometry_mul
proof:

  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
  calc
    W.conjTranspose * V.conjTranspose * (V * W) =
        W.conjTranspose * ((V.conjTranspose * V) * W) := by
