name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.isometry_ranges_intersect
statement:
theorem isometry_ranges_intersect
    {n p q : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) 𝕜)
    (W : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin q) 𝕜)
    (hV : MatrixIsometry V) (hW : MatrixIsometry W)
    (hdim : n < p + q) :
    ∃ (x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin p))
      (y : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin q)),
        x ≠ 0 ∧ y ≠ 0 ∧ V.mulVec x.ofLp = W.mulVec y.ofLp
proof:
:= by
  let LV := Matrix.toEuclideanLin V
  let LW := Matrix.toEuclideanLin W
  let F :
      (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin p) × EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin q)) →ₗ[𝕜]
        EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n) :=
    LV.comp (LinearMap.fst 𝕜 _ _) - LW.comp (LinearMap.snd 𝕜 _ _)
  have hrank : Module.finrank 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n)) <
      Module.finrank 𝕜
        (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin p) × EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin q)) := by
    simpa using hdim
  have hker : F.ker ≠ ⊥ := LinearMap.ker_ne_bot_of_finrank_lt hrank
  obtain ⟨z, hzmem, hz0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hker
  rcases z with ⟨x, y⟩
  have hzero : F (x, y) = 0 := hzmem
  have heq : LV x = LW y := by
    have : LV x - LW y = 0 := by simpa [F] using hzero
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
  have hLV : Function.Injective LV :=
    toEuclideanLin_injective_of_isometry hV
  have hLW : Function.Injective LW :=
    toEuclideanLin_injective_of_isometry hW
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    have hy : y = 0 := hLW (by simpa [hx] using heq.symm)
    exact hz0 (by simp [hx, hy])
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    intro hy
    have hx : x = 0 := hLV (by simpa [hy] using heq)
    exact hz0 (by simp [hx, hy])
  have hraw : V.mulVec x.ofLp = W.mulVec y.ofLp := by
    have h := congrArg WithLp.ofLp heq
    simpa [LV, LW, Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply] using h
  exact ⟨x, y, hx0, hy0, hraw⟩

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.decreasingEigenvalues_compress_le_proved
statement:
theorem decreasingEigenvalues_compress_le_proved
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (hkn : k ≤ n)
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜} (hV : MatrixIsometry V)
    (i : Fin k) :
    decreasingEigenvalues (compress_isHermitian hA V) i ≤
      decreasingEigenvalues hA (Fin.castLE hkn i)
proof:
:= by
  let B : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) 𝕜 := compress V A
  let hB : B.IsHermitian := compress_isHermitian hA V
  let UB : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (i.val + 1)) 𝕜 :=
    spectralIsometry hB (topFinEmbeddingAt i)
  let j : Fin n := Fin.castLE hkn i
  let WA : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (n - j.val)) 𝕜 :=
    spectralIsometry hA (bottomFinEmbeddingAt j)
  let W : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (i.val + 1)) 𝕜 := V * UB
  have hUB : MatrixIsometry UB :=
    spectralIsometry_isometry hB (topFinEmbeddingAt i)
  have hWA : MatrixIsometry WA :=
    spectralIsometry_isometry hA (bottomFinEmbeddingAt j)
  have hW : MatrixIsometry W := matrixIsometry_mul hV hUB
  have hdim : n < (i.val + 1) + (n - j.val) := by
    dsimp [j]
    omega
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx0, _hy0, hxy⟩ :=
    isometry_ranges_intersect W WA hW hWA hdim
  let v : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n) := Matrix.toEuclideanLin W x
  have hxyRaw :
      V.mulVec (UB.mulVec x.ofLp) = WA.mulVec y.ofLp := by
    simpa [W, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using hxy
  have hnormX : ‖x‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    exact (norm_toEuclideanLin_of_isometry hW x).symm
  have hnormY : ‖y‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    have heq : Matrix.toEuclideanLin WA y = v := by
      apply WithLp.ofLp_injective 2
      simpa [v, W, Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply,
        Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using hxy.symm
    rw [← heq]
    exact (norm_toEuclideanLin_of_isometry hWA y).symm
  have hchain : decreasingEigenvalues hB i * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤
      decreasingEigenvalues hA j * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      decreasingEigenvalues hB i * ‖v‖ ^ 2 =
          decreasingEigenvalues hB i * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by rw [hnormX]
      _ ≤ realQuadraticForm B (UB.mulVec x.ofLp) :=
        top_spectral_quadratic_lower hB i x
      _ = realQuadraticForm A (V.mulVec (UB.mulVec x.ofLp)) :=
        (realQuadraticForm_mulVec V A (UB.mulVec x.ofLp)).symm
      _ = realQuadraticForm A (WA.mulVec y.ofLp) := by rw [hxyRaw]
      _ ≤ decreasingEigenvalues hA j * ‖y‖ ^ 2 :=
        bottom_spectral_quadratic_upper hA j y
      _ = decreasingEigenvalues hA j * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by rw [hnormY]
  have hv0 : 0 < ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
    have hvne : v ≠ 0 := by
      intro hv
      have hx : x = 0 :=
        (toEuclideanLin_injective_of_isometry hW) (by simpa [v] using hv)
      exact hx0 hx
    positivity
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hchain hv0

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.decreasingEigenvalues_compress_ge_proved
statement:
theorem decreasingEigenvalues_compress_ge_proved
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (hkn : k ≤ n)
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜} (hV : MatrixIsometry V)
    (i : Fin k) :
    decreasingEigenvalues (compress_isHermitian hA V) i ≥
      decreasingEigenvalues hA (bottomFinEmbedding hkn i)
proof:
:= by
  let B : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) 𝕜 := compress V A
  let hB : B.IsHermitian := compress_isHermitian hA V
  let j : Fin n := bottomFinEmbedding hkn i
  let UA : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (j.val + 1)) 𝕜 :=
    spectralIsometry hA (topFinEmbeddingAt j)
  let UB : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k - i.val)) 𝕜 :=
    spectralIsometry hB (bottomFinEmbeddingAt i)
  let W : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k - i.val)) 𝕜 := V * UB
  have hUA : MatrixIsometry UA :=
    spectralIsometry_isometry hA (topFinEmbeddingAt j)
  have hUB : MatrixIsometry UB :=
    spectralIsometry_isometry hB (bottomFinEmbeddingAt i)
  have hW : MatrixIsometry W := matrixIsometry_mul hV hUB
  have hdim : n < (j.val + 1) + (k - i.val) := by
    dsimp [j, bottomFinEmbedding]
    omega
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx0, _hy0, hxy⟩ :=
    isometry_ranges_intersect UA W hUA hW hdim
  let v : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n) := Matrix.toEuclideanLin UA x
  have hxyRaw :
      UA.mulVec x.ofLp = V.mulVec (UB.mulVec y.ofLp) := by
    simpa [W, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using hxy
  have hnormX : ‖x‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    exact (norm_toEuclideanLin_of_isometry hUA x).symm
  have hnormY : ‖y‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    have heq : Matrix.toEuclideanLin W y = v := by
      apply WithLp.ofLp_injective 2
      simpa [v, W, Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply,
        Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using hxy.symm
    rw [← heq]
    exact (norm_toEuclideanLin_of_isometry hW y).symm
  have hchain : decreasingEigenvalues hA j * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤
      decreasingEigenvalues hB i * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      decreasingEigenvalues hA j * ‖v‖ ^ 2 =
          decreasingEigenvalues hA j * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by rw [hnormX]
      _ ≤ realQuadraticForm A (UA.mulVec x.ofLp) :=
        top_spectral_quadratic_lower hA j x
      _ = realQuadraticForm A (V.mulVec (UB.mulVec y.ofLp)) := by rw [hxyRaw]
      _ = realQuadraticForm B (UB.mulVec y.ofLp) :=
        realQuadraticForm_mulVec V A (UB.mulVec y.ofLp)
      _ ≤ decreasingEigenvalues hB i * ‖y‖ ^ 2 :=
        bottom_spectral_quadratic_upper hB i y
      _ = decreasingEigenvalues hB i * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by rw [hnormY]
  have hv0 : 0 < ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
    have hvne : v ≠ 0 := by
      intro hv
      have hx : x = 0 :=
        (toEuclideanLin_injective_of_isometry hUA) (by simpa [v] using hv)
      exact hx0 hx
    positivity
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hchain hv0

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.interlacing_from_spectral
statement:
theorem interlacing_from_spectral
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] : Interlacing 𝕜
proof:
:= by
  intro n k hkn A V hA hV i
  exact ⟨decreasingEigenvalues_compress_le_proved hkn hA hV i,
    decreasingEigenvalues_compress_ge_proved hkn hA hV i⟩

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.spectralIsometry_isometry
statement:
theorem spectralIsometry_isometry
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (e : Fin k ↪ Fin n) : MatrixIsometry (spectralIsometry hA e)
proof:
:= by
  have hU := decreasingEigenvectorUnitary_isometry hA
  ext i j
  have hij := congrArg
    (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 ↦ M (e i) (e j)) hU
  simpa [MatrixIsometry, spectralIsometry, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.one_apply] using hij

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.mul_spectralIsometry
statement:
theorem mul_spectralIsometry
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (e : Fin k ↪ Fin n) :
    A * spectralIsometry hA e =
      spectralIsometry hA e * Matrix.diagonal
        (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal (decreasingEigenvalues hA (e i)))
proof:
:= by
  have hU := mul_decreasingEigenvectorUnitary hA
  ext p i
  have hi := congrArg
    (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 ↦ M p (e i)) hU
  rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal] at hi
  rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  simpa [spectralIsometry, Matrix.mul_apply] using hi

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.compress_spectralIsometry
statement:
theorem compress_spectralIsometry
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (e : Fin k ↪ Fin n) :
    compress (spectralIsometry hA e) A =
      Matrix.diagonal
        (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal (decreasingEigenvalues hA (e i)))
proof:
:= by
  let V := spectralIsometry hA e
  let D : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) 𝕜 := Matrix.diagonal
    (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal (decreasingEigenvalues hA (e i)))
  have hV : MatrixIsometry V := spectralIsometry_isometry hA e
  have hrel : A * V = V * D := mul_spectralIsometry hA e
  calc
    compress V A = V.conjTranspose * (A * V) := by
      simp [compress, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = V.conjTranspose * (V * D) := by rw [hrel]
    _ = (V.conjTranspose * V) * D := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = D := by rw [hV, Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = Matrix.diagonal
        (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal (decreasingEigenvalues hA (e i))) := rfl

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.toEuclideanLin_injective_of_isometry
statement:
theorem toEuclideanLin_injective_of_isometry
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜} (hV : MatrixIsometry V) :
    Function.Injective (Matrix.toEuclideanLin V)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply WithLp.ofLp_injective 2
  apply hV.mulVec_injective
  have h := congrArg WithLp.ofLp hxy
  simpa [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply] using h

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.spectral_subspaces_intersect
statement:
theorem spectral_subspaces_intersect
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i : Fin n) :
    ∃ (x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin (i.val + 1)))
      (y : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin (n - i.val))),
        x ≠ 0 ∧ y ≠ 0 ∧
          Matrix.toEuclideanLin
              (spectralIsometry hA (topFinEmbeddingAt i)) x =
            Matrix.toEuclideanLin
              (spectralIsometry hB (bottomFinEmbeddingAt i)) y
proof:
:= by
  let VA := spectralIsometry hA (topFinEmbeddingAt i)
  let VB := spectralIsometry hB (bottomFinEmbeddingAt i)
  let LA := Matrix.toEuclideanLin VA
  let LB := Matrix.toEuclideanLin VB
  let F :
      (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin (i.val + 1)) ×
          EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin (n - i.val))) →ₗ[𝕜]
        EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n) :=
    LA.comp (LinearMap.fst 𝕜 _ _) - LB.comp (LinearMap.snd 𝕜 _ _)
  have hrank : Module.finrank 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n)) <
      Module.finrank 𝕜
        (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin (i.val + 1)) ×
          EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin (n - i.val))) := by
    simp
    omega
  have hker : F.ker ≠ ⊥ := LinearMap.ker_ne_bot_of_finrank_lt hrank
  obtain ⟨z, hzmem, hz0⟩ :=
    Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hker
  rcases z with ⟨x, y⟩
  have hzero : F (x, y) = 0 := hzmem
  have heq : LA x = LB y := by
    have : LA x - LB y = 0 := by simpa [F] using hzero
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
  have hLA : Function.Injective LA := by
    exact toEuclideanLin_injective_of_isometry
      (spectralIsometry_isometry hA (topFinEmbeddingAt i))
  have hLB : Function.Injective LB := by
    exact toEuclideanLin_injective_of_isometry
      (spectralIsometry_isometry hB (bottomFinEmbeddingAt i))
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    have hy : y = 0 := hLB (by simpa [hx] using heq.symm)
    exact hz0 (by simp [hx, hy])
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    intro hy
    have hx : x = 0 := hLA (by simpa [hy] using heq)
    exact hz0 (by simp [hx, hy])
  exact ⟨x, y, hx0, hy0, by simpa [LA, LB, VA, VB] using heq⟩

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.star_mulVec
statement:
theorem star_mulVec
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype n] {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    star (A.mulVec x) = Matrix.vecMul (star x) A.conjTranspose
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change star (∑ j, A i j * x j) = ∑ j, star (x j) * star (A i j)
  simp [mul_comm]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.realQuadraticForm_mulVec
statement:
theorem realQuadraticForm_mulVec
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (V : Matrix m n 𝕜) (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    realQuadraticForm A (V.mulVec x) =
      realQuadraticForm (compress V A) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold realQuadraticForm compress
  congr 1
  rw [star_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec,
    Matrix.vecMul_vecMul, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]
  simp [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.realQuadraticForm_diagonal
statement:
theorem realQuadraticForm_diagonal
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (d : n → ℝ) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    realQuadraticForm
        (Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal (d i))) x =
      ∑ i, d i * ‖x i‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : (Matrix.diagonal
      (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal (d i))).mulVec x =
      fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal (d i) * x i := by
    ext i
    simp [Matrix.mulVec]
  unfold realQuadraticForm
  rw [hmul]
  simp only [dotProduct]
  change RCLike.re (∑ i, star (x i) *
      (RCLike.ofReal (d i) * x i)) = _
  rw [show RCLike.re (∑ i, star (x i) *
      (RCLike.ofReal (d i) * x i)) =
      ∑ i, RCLike.re (star (x i) *
        (RCLike.ofReal (d i) * x i)) by
    exact map_sum RCLike.reLm _ Finset.univ]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [RCLike.norm_sq_eq_def]
  simp [RCLike.mul_re, RCLike.star_def]
  ring

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.realQuadraticForm_mono
statement:
theorem realQuadraticForm_mono
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n]
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hAB : A ≤ B) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    realQuadraticForm A x ≤ realQuadraticForm B x
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hAB).re_dotProduct_nonneg x
  unfold realQuadraticForm
  simpa [Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub] using hnonneg

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.norm_toEuclideanLin_of_isometry
statement:
theorem norm_toEuclideanLin_of_isometry
    {m n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hV : MatrixIsometry V)
    (x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n)) :
    ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin V x‖ = ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  have qform_one (r : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin r)) :
      realQuadraticForm (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) 𝕜) z.ofLp = ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
    unfold realQuadraticForm
    rw [Matrix.one_mulVec, dotProduct_comm,
      ← EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
    exact inner_self_eq_norm_sq (𝕜 := 𝕜) z
  have hq := realQuadraticForm_mulVec V
    (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜) x.ofLp
  have hcomp : compress V (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜) = 1 := by
    simpa [compress, MatrixIsometry] using hV
  rw [hcomp] at hq
  have hout : realQuadraticForm (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜)
      (V.mulVec x.ofLp) = ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin V x‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply] using
      qform_one m (Matrix.toEuclideanLin V x)
  have hin := qform_one n x
  rw [hout, hin] at hq
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (Matrix.toEuclideanLin V x), norm_nonneg x]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.realQuadraticForm_one
statement:
theorem realQuadraticForm_one
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] (x : n → 𝕜) :
    realQuadraticForm (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) x = ∑ i, ‖x i‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hone : (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun _ ↦ RCLike.ofReal 1) := by
    simp
  rw [hone, realQuadraticForm_diagonal]
  simp

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.realQuadraticForm_scalar
statement:
theorem realQuadraticForm_scalar
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] (c : ℝ) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    realQuadraticForm (Matrix.scalar n (RCLike.ofReal c)) x =
      c * realQuadraticForm (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.scalar_apply, realQuadraticForm_diagonal,
    realQuadraticForm_one, Finset.mul_sum]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.top_spectral_quadratic_lower
statement:
theorem top_spectral_quadratic_lower
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (i : Fin n) (x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin (i.val + 1))) :
    decreasingEigenvalues hA i * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤
      realQuadraticForm A
        ((spectralIsometry hA (topFinEmbeddingAt i)).mulVec x.ofLp)
proof:
:= by
  let e := topFinEmbeddingAt i
  let V := spectralIsometry hA e
  calc
    decreasingEigenvalues hA i * ‖x‖ ^ 2 =
        ∑ j, decreasingEigenvalues hA i * ‖x.ofLp j‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ j, decreasingEigenvalues hA (e j) * ‖x.ofLp j‖ ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      have hji : e j ≤ i := by
        change j.val ≤ i.val
        omega
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (decreasingEigenvalues_antitone hA hji) (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = realQuadraticForm
        (Matrix.diagonal
          (fun j ↦ RCLike.ofReal (decreasingEigenvalues hA (e j))))
        x.ofLp := (realQuadraticForm_diagonal _ _).symm
    _ = realQuadraticForm (compress V A) x.ofLp := by
      rw [compress_spectralIsometry]
    _ = realQuadraticForm A (V.mulVec x.ofLp) :=
      (realQuadraticForm_mulVec V A x.ofLp).symm
    _ = realQuadraticForm A
        ((spectralIsometry hA (topFinEmbeddingAt i)).mulVec x.ofLp) := rfl

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.bottom_spectral_quadratic_upper
statement:
theorem bottom_spectral_quadratic_upper
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (i : Fin n) (x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin (n - i.val))) :
    realQuadraticForm A
        ((spectralIsometry hA (bottomFinEmbeddingAt i)).mulVec x.ofLp) ≤
      decreasingEigenvalues hA i * ‖x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let e := bottomFinEmbeddingAt i
  let V := spectralIsometry hA e
  calc
    realQuadraticForm A (V.mulVec x.ofLp) =
        realQuadraticForm (compress V A) x.ofLp :=
      realQuadraticForm_mulVec V A x.ofLp
    _ = realQuadraticForm
        (Matrix.diagonal
          (fun j ↦ RCLike.ofReal (decreasingEigenvalues hA (e j))))
        x.ofLp := by
      rw [compress_spectralIsometry]
    _ = ∑ j, decreasingEigenvalues hA (e j) * ‖x.ofLp j‖ ^ 2 :=
      realQuadraticForm_diagonal _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ j, decreasingEigenvalues hA i * ‖x.ofLp j‖ ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      have hij : i ≤ e j := by
        change i.val ≤ n - (n - i.val) + j.val
        omega
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (decreasingEigenvalues_antitone hA hij) (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = decreasingEigenvalues hA i * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Finset.mul_sum]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.decreasingEigenvalues_le_of_quadratic_le
statement:
theorem decreasingEigenvalues_le_of_quadratic_le
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hquad : ∀ v : Fin n → 𝕜,
      realQuadraticForm A v ≤ c * realQuadraticForm B v)
    (i : Fin n) :
    decreasingEigenvalues hA i ≤ c * decreasingEigenvalues hB i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx0, _hy0, hxy⟩ :=
    spectral_subspaces_intersect hA hB i
  let VA := spectralIsometry hA (topFinEmbeddingAt i)
  let VB := spectralIsometry hB (bottomFinEmbeddingAt i)
  let v : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n) := Matrix.toEuclideanLin VA x
  have hxyRaw : VA.mulVec x.ofLp = VB.mulVec y.ofLp := by
    have h := congrArg WithLp.ofLp hxy
    simpa [VA, VB, Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply] using h
  have hnormVA : ‖x‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    exact (norm_toEuclideanLin_of_isometry
      (spectralIsometry_isometry hA (topFinEmbeddingAt i)) x).symm
  have hnormVB : ‖y‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    have heqv : Matrix.toEuclideanLin VB y = v := hxy.symm
    rw [← heqv]
    exact (norm_toEuclideanLin_of_isometry
      (spectralIsometry_isometry hB (bottomFinEmbeddingAt i)) y).symm
  have hchain : decreasingEigenvalues hA i * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (c * decreasingEigenvalues hB i) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      decreasingEigenvalues hA i * ‖v‖ ^ 2 =
          decreasingEigenvalues hA i * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by rw [hnormVA]
      _ ≤ realQuadraticForm A (VA.mulVec x.ofLp) :=
        top_spectral_quadratic_lower hA i x
      _ ≤ c * realQuadraticForm B (VA.mulVec x.ofLp) := hquad _
      _ = c * realQuadraticForm B (VB.mulVec y.ofLp) := by rw [hxyRaw]
      _ ≤ c * (decreasingEigenvalues hB i * ‖y‖ ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (bottom_spectral_quadratic_upper hB i y) hc
      _ = (c * decreasingEigenvalues hB i) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [hnormVB]
        ring
  have hv0 : 0 < ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
    have hvne : v ≠ 0 := by
      intro hv
      have hx : x = 0 :=
        (toEuclideanLin_injective_of_isometry
          (spectralIsometry_isometry hA (topFinEmbeddingAt i)))
          (by simpa [v] using hv)
      exact hx0 hx
    positivity
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hchain hv0

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.decreasingEigenvalues_mono
statement:
theorem decreasingEigenvalues_mono
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hAB : A ≤ B)
    (i : Fin n) :
    decreasingEigenvalues hA i ≤ decreasingEigenvalues hB i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx0, _hy0, hxy⟩ :=
    spectral_subspaces_intersect hA hB i
  let VA := spectralIsometry hA (topFinEmbeddingAt i)
  let VB := spectralIsometry hB (bottomFinEmbeddingAt i)
  let v : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n) := Matrix.toEuclideanLin VA x
  have hxyRaw : VA.mulVec x.ofLp = VB.mulVec y.ofLp := by
    have h := congrArg WithLp.ofLp hxy
    simpa [VA, VB, Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply] using h
  have hnormVA : ‖x‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    exact (norm_toEuclideanLin_of_isometry
      (spectralIsometry_isometry hA (topFinEmbeddingAt i)) x).symm
  have hnormVB : ‖y‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    have heqv : Matrix.toEuclideanLin VB y = v := hxy.symm
    rw [← heqv]
    exact (norm_toEuclideanLin_of_isometry
      (spectralIsometry_isometry hB (bottomFinEmbeddingAt i)) y).symm
  have hchain : decreasingEigenvalues hA i * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤
      decreasingEigenvalues hB i * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      decreasingEigenvalues hA i * ‖v‖ ^ 2 =
          decreasingEigenvalues hA i * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by rw [hnormVA]
      _ ≤ realQuadraticForm A (VA.mulVec x.ofLp) :=
        top_spectral_quadratic_lower hA i x
      _ ≤ realQuadraticForm B (VA.mulVec x.ofLp) :=
        realQuadraticForm_mono hAB _
      _ = realQuadraticForm B (VB.mulVec y.ofLp) := by rw [hxyRaw]
      _ ≤ decreasingEigenvalues hB i * ‖y‖ ^ 2 :=
        bottom_spectral_quadratic_upper hB i y
      _ = decreasingEigenvalues hB i * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by rw [hnormVB]
  have hv0 : 0 < ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
    have hvne : v ≠ 0 := by
      intro hv
      have hx : x = 0 :=
        (toEuclideanLin_injective_of_isometry
          (spectralIsometry_isometry hA (topFinEmbeddingAt i)))
          (by simpa [v] using hv)
      exact hx0 hx
    positivity
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hchain hv0

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.realQuadraticForm_gram_mul
statement:
theorem realQuadraticForm_gram_mul
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (Y Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) (x : Fin n → 𝕜) :
    realQuadraticForm ((Y * Z).conjTranspose * (Y * Z)) x =
      realQuadraticForm (Y.conjTranspose * Y) (Z.mulVec x)
proof:
:= by
  have hgram : (Y * Z).conjTranspose * (Y * Z) =
      compress Z (Y.conjTranspose * Y) := by
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, compress]
    noncomm_ring
  rw [hgram]
  exact (realQuadraticForm_mulVec Z (Y.conjTranspose * Y) x).symm

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.realQuadraticForm_gram
statement:
theorem realQuadraticForm_gram
    {m n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (Z : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) (x : Fin n → 𝕜) :
    realQuadraticForm (Z.conjTranspose * Z) x =
      realQuadraticForm (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜) (Z.mulVec x)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : compress Z (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜) =
      Z.conjTranspose * Z := by simp [compress]
  rw [← hcomp]
  exact (realQuadraticForm_mulVec Z 1 x).symm

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.singularValues_mul_le_of_gram_le
statement:
theorem singularValues_mul_le_of_gram_le
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (Y Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hY : Y.conjTranspose * Y ≤
      Matrix.scalar (Fin n) (RCLike.ofReal (c ^ 2)))
    (i : Fin n) :
    (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (Y * Z)).singularValues i ≤
      c * (Matrix.toEuclideanLin Z).singularValues i
proof:
:= by
  let GYZ := (Y * Z).conjTranspose * (Y * Z)
  let GZ := Z.conjTranspose * Z
  have hquad : ∀ x : Fin n → 𝕜,
      realQuadraticForm GYZ x ≤ c ^ 2 * realQuadraticForm GZ x := by
    intro x
    calc
      realQuadraticForm GYZ x =
          realQuadraticForm (Y.conjTranspose * Y) (Z.mulVec x) := by
        exact realQuadraticForm_gram_mul Y Z x
      _ ≤ realQuadraticForm
          (Matrix.scalar (Fin n) (RCLike.ofReal (c ^ 2)))
          (Z.mulVec x) := realQuadraticForm_mono hY _
      _ = c ^ 2 * realQuadraticForm
          (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) (Z.mulVec x) :=
        realQuadraticForm_scalar _ _
      _ = c ^ 2 * realQuadraticForm GZ x := by
        rw [realQuadraticForm_gram]
  have heig : decreasingEigenvalues
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (Y * Z)) i ≤
      c ^ 2 * decreasingEigenvalues
        (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self Z) i := by
    exact decreasingEigenvalues_le_of_quadratic_le
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (Y * Z))
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self Z) (c ^ 2) (sq_nonneg c)
      hquad i
  have hleft := singularValues_sq_eq_decreasingEigenvalues_gram (Y * Z) i
  have hright := singularValues_sq_eq_decreasingEigenvalues_gram Z i
  rw [← hleft, ← hright] at heig
  have hsq : (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (Y * Z)).singularValues i ^ 2 ≤
      (c * (Matrix.toEuclideanLin Z).singularValues i) ^ 2 := by
    simpa [mul_pow] using heig
  exact (sq_le_sq₀
    (LinearMap.singularValues_nonneg (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (Y * Z)) i)
    (mul_nonneg hc
      (LinearMap.singularValues_nonneg (Matrix.toEuclideanLin Z) i))).mp hsq

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.singularValues_le_mul_of_one_le_gram
statement:
theorem singularValues_le_mul_of_one_le_gram
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (X T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (hX : (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) ≤ X.conjTranspose * X)
    (i : Fin n) :
    (Matrix.toEuclideanLin T).singularValues i ≤
      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (X * T)).singularValues i
proof:
:= by
  have hgram : T.conjTranspose * T ≤
      (X * T).conjTranspose * (X * T) := by
    have h := compress_mono T hX
    simpa only [compress, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.mul_assoc] using h
  have heig := decreasingEigenvalues_mono
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self T)
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (X * T)) hgram i
  have hleft := singularValues_sq_eq_decreasingEigenvalues_gram T i
  have hright := singularValues_sq_eq_decreasingEigenvalues_gram (X * T) i
  rw [← hleft, ← hright] at heig
  exact (sq_le_sq₀
    (LinearMap.singularValues_nonneg (Matrix.toEuclideanLin T) i)
    (LinearMap.singularValues_nonneg (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (X * T)) i)).mp
      heig

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.prod_singularValues_eq_normDet
statement:
theorem prod_singularValues_eq_normDet
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (T : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n) →ₗ[𝕜]
      EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n)) :
    (∏ i : Fin n, T.singularValues i) = T.normDet
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.normDet_eq_prod_singularValues]
  simpa using Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range T.singularValues n

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.normDet_comp
statement:
theorem normDet_comp
    {E : Type*} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
    [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E]
    (S T : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) :
    (S.comp T).normDet = S.normDet * T.normDet
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.normDet_eq_norm_det, LinearMap.normDet_eq_norm_det,
    LinearMap.normDet_eq_norm_det, LinearMap.det_comp, norm_mul]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.prod_embedding_le_prod
statement:
theorem prod_embedding_le_prod
    {n k : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, 1 ≤ f i)
    (e : Fin k ↪ Fin n) :
    (∏ j, f (e j)) ≤ ∏ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  let s : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.map e
  have hsubset : s ⊆ Finset.univ := Finset.subset_univ s
  have hprod := Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le hsubset
    (fun i _ ↦ le_trans (by norm_num) (hf i))
    (fun i _ _ ↦ hf i)
  simpa [s] using hprod

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.expanding_selected_product_of_injective
statement:
theorem expanding_selected_product_of_injective
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (X T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (hX : (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) ≤ X.conjTranspose * X)
    (hT : Function.Injective (Matrix.toEuclideanLin T))
    (indices : Fin k ↪ Fin n) :
    (∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (X * T)).singularValues (indices j)) ≤
      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin X).normDet *
        ∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin T).singularValues (indices j)
proof:
:= by
  let LX := Matrix.toEuclideanLin X
  let LT := Matrix.toEuclideanLin T
  let LXT := Matrix.toEuclideanLin (X * T)
  let ratio : Fin n → ℝ := fun i ↦
    LXT.singularValues i / LT.singularValues i
  have hTpos : ∀ i : Fin n, 0 < LT.singularValues i := by
    intro i
    have hall :=
      (LinearMap.injective_iff_forall_lt_finrank_singularValues_pos LT).mp hT
    exact hall i (by simp)
  have hmono : ∀ i : Fin n,
      LT.singularValues i ≤ LXT.singularValues i := by
    intro i
    exact singularValues_le_mul_of_one_le_gram X T hX i
  have hratio : ∀ i : Fin n, 1 ≤ ratio i := by
    intro i
    exact (le_div_iff₀ (hTpos i)).2 (by simpa using hmono i)
  have hselected : (∏ j, ratio (indices j)) ≤ ∏ i, ratio i :=
    prod_embedding_le_prod ratio hratio indices
  have hTprod : 0 < ∏ i : Fin n, LT.singularValues i :=
    Finset.prod_pos fun i _ ↦ hTpos i
  have hcomp : LXT = LX.comp LT := by
    simp [LX, LT, LXT]
  have hfull : (∏ i : Fin n, ratio i) = LX.normDet := by
    rw [show (∏ i : Fin n, ratio i) =
        (∏ i : Fin n, LXT.singularValues i) /
          ∏ i : Fin n, LT.singularValues i by
      simp [ratio, Finset.prod_div_distrib]]
    rw [prod_singularValues_eq_normDet,
      prod_singularValues_eq_normDet, hcomp, normDet_comp]
    have hTnorm : LT.normDet ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← prod_singularValues_eq_normDet]
      exact hTprod.ne'
    exact mul_div_cancel_right₀ LX.normDet hTnorm
  have hfactor : (∏ j : Fin k, LXT.singularValues (indices j)) =
      (∏ j : Fin k, ratio (indices j)) *
        ∏ j : Fin k, LT.singularValues (indices j) := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro j _
    dsimp [ratio]
    field_simp [(hTpos (indices j)).ne']
  rw [hfactor]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hfull ▸ hselected)
    (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ ↦
      LinearMap.singularValues_nonneg LT (indices j))

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.selected_product_of_factorization
statement:
theorem selected_product_of_factorization
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (S T X Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hfactor : S = Y * X)
    (hY : Y.conjTranspose * Y ≤
      Matrix.scalar (Fin n) (RCLike.ofReal (c ^ 2)))
    (hX : (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) ≤ X.conjTranspose * X)
    (hvolume : c ^ k * (Matrix.toEuclideanLin X).normDet =
      ∏ j : Fin k, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues j)
    (hT : Function.Injective (Matrix.toEuclideanLin T))
    (indices : Fin k ↪ Fin n) :
    (∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (S * T)).singularValues (indices j)) ≤
      (∏ j : Fin k, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues j) *
        ∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin T).singularValues (indices j)
proof:
:= by
  have hideal : ∀ j : Fin k,
      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (S * T)).singularValues (indices j) ≤
        c * (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (X * T)).singularValues (indices j) := by
    intro j
    have hmat : S * T = Y * (X * T) := by rw [hfactor, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [hmat]
    exact singularValues_mul_le_of_gram_le Y (X * T) c hc hY (indices j)
  have hfirst :
      (∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (S * T)).singularValues (indices j)) ≤
        c ^ k *
          ∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (X * T)).singularValues (indices j) := by
    calc
      (∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (S * T)).singularValues (indices j)) ≤
          ∏ j, (c *
            (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (X * T)).singularValues (indices j)) := by
        exact Finset.prod_le_prod
          (fun j _ ↦ LinearMap.singularValues_nonneg _ _) (fun j _ ↦ hideal j)
      _ = c ^ k *
          ∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (X * T)).singularValues (indices j) := by
        calc
          (∏ j : Fin k, c *
              (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (X * T)).singularValues (indices j)) =
              (∏ _j : Fin k, c) *
                ∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (X * T)).singularValues
                  (indices j) := by
            simpa using (Finset.prod_mul_distrib
              (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)))
              (f := fun _j : Fin k ↦ c)
              (g := fun j : Fin k ↦
                (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (X * T)).singularValues (indices j)))
          _ = c ^ k *
                ∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (X * T)).singularValues
                  (indices j) := by simp
  have hexpand := expanding_selected_product_of_injective X T hX hT indices
  calc
    (∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (S * T)).singularValues (indices j)) ≤
        c ^ k *
          ∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (X * T)).singularValues (indices j) :=
      hfirst
    _ ≤ c ^ k * ((Matrix.toEuclideanLin X).normDet *
        ∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin T).singularValues (indices j)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexpand (pow_nonneg hc k)
    _ = (∏ j : Fin k,
          (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues j) *
        ∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin T).singularValues (indices j) := by
      rw [← hvolume]
      ring

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.hiaiScale_eq_of_lt
statement:
theorem hiaiScale_eq_of_lt
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hkn : k ≤ n) (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val < k) :
    hiaiScale S hk hkn i =
      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues i /
        (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn)
proof:
:= by
  simp [hiaiScale, hi]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.hiaiScale_eq_one_of_le
statement:
theorem hiaiScale_eq_one_of_le
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hkn : k ≤ n) (i : Fin n) (hi : k ≤ i.val) :
    hiaiScale S hk hkn i = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [hiaiScale, not_lt.mpr hi]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.hiaiScale_one_le
statement:
theorem hiaiScale_one_le
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (ha : 0 < (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn))
    (i : Fin n) :
    1 ≤ hiaiScale S hk hkn i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i.val < k
  · rw [hiaiScale_eq_of_lt S hk hkn i hi]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ ha).2
    simpa using (LinearMap.singularValues_antitone
      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S) (show i.val ≤ (kthIndex hk hkn).val by
        change i.val ≤ k - 1
        omega))
  · rw [hiaiScale_eq_one_of_le S hk hkn i (not_lt.mp hi)]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.hiaiScale_pos
statement:
theorem hiaiScale_pos
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (ha : 0 < (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn))
    (i : Fin n) :
    0 < hiaiScale S hk hkn i
proof:
:=
  lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hiaiScale_one_le S hk hkn ha i)

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.hiaiScale_antitone
statement:
theorem hiaiScale_antitone
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (ha : 0 < (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn)) :
    Antitone (hiaiScale S hk hkn)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  by_cases hj : j.val < k
  · have hi : i.val < k := lt_of_le_of_lt hij hj
    rw [hiaiScale_eq_of_lt S hk hkn i hi,
      hiaiScale_eq_of_lt S hk hkn j hj]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (LinearMap.singularValues_antitone _ hij) ha.le
  · rw [hiaiScale_eq_one_of_le S hk hkn j (not_lt.mp hj)]
    exact hiaiScale_one_le S hk hkn ha i

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.hiaiScale_sq_antitone
statement:
theorem hiaiScale_sq_antitone
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (ha : 0 < (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn)) :
    Antitone (fun i ↦ hiaiScale S hk hkn i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (hiaiScale_pos S hk hkn ha j).le
    (hiaiScale_antitone S hk hkn ha hij) 2

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.gramEigenvalue_div_hiaiScale_sq_le
statement:
theorem gramEigenvalue_div_hiaiScale_sq_le
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (ha : 0 < (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn))
    (i : Fin n) :
    decreasingEigenvalues
        (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self S) i /
          hiaiScale S hk hkn i ^ 2 ≤
      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let a := (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn)
  let s := (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues i
  have heig := singularValues_sq_eq_decreasingEigenvalues_gram S i
  by_cases hi : i.val < k
  · rw [← heig, hiaiScale_eq_of_lt S hk hkn i hi]
    change s ^ 2 / (s / a) ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2
    have hai : a ≤ s := by
      exact LinearMap.singularValues_antitone (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S) <| by
        change i.val ≤ k - 1
        omega
    have hsi : 0 < s := lt_of_lt_of_le ha hai
    have hsne : s ≠ 0 := hsi.ne'
    have hane : a ≠ 0 := ha.ne'
    field_simp [hsne, hane]
    exact le_rfl
  · rw [← heig, hiaiScale_eq_one_of_le S hk hkn i (not_lt.mp hi)]
    simp only [one_pow, div_one]
    have hsi : s ≤ a := by
      exact LinearMap.singularValues_antitone (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S) <| by
        change k - 1 ≤ i.val
        omega
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (LinearMap.singularValues_nonneg _ _) hsi 2

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.hiaiScale_volume_identity
statement:
theorem hiaiScale_volume_identity
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (ha : 0 < (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn)) :
    (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn) ^ k *
        (∏ i : Fin n, hiaiScale S hk hkn i) =
      ∏ j : Fin k, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues j
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin k ↪ Fin n := Fin.castLEEmb hkn
  let s : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.map e
  let a := (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn)
  have hsub : s ⊆ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) := Finset.subset_univ s
  have houtside : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)), i ∉ s →
      hiaiScale S hk hkn i = 1 := by
    intro i _ hi
    have hik : k ≤ i.val := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hlt : i.val < k := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnot
      let j : Fin k := ⟨i.val, hlt⟩
      have hej : e j = i := by apply Fin.ext; rfl
      exact hi (by
        simp only [s, Finset.mem_map, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        exact ⟨j, hej⟩)
    exact hiaiScale_eq_one_of_le S hk hkn i hik
  have hrestrict :
      (∏ i ∈ s, hiaiScale S hk hkn i) =
        ∏ i : Fin n, hiaiScale S hk hkn i := by
    simpa using Finset.prod_subset hsub houtside
  have hmap :
      (∏ i ∈ s, hiaiScale S hk hkn i) =
        ∏ j : Fin k, hiaiScale S hk hkn (e j) := by
    simp [s]
  have hscaleTop : ∀ j : Fin k,
      hiaiScale S hk hkn (e j) =
        (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues j / a := by
    intro j
    rw [hiaiScale_eq_of_lt S hk hkn (e j) (by simp [e, j.isLt])]
    rfl
  have hprod : (∏ i : Fin n, hiaiScale S hk hkn i) =
      (∏ j : Fin k, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues j) /
        a ^ k := by
    rw [← hrestrict, hmap]
    simp_rw [hscaleTop]
    rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib]
    simp
  change a ^ k * (∏ i : Fin n, hiaiScale S hk hkn i) = _
  rw [hprod]
  exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ (pow_ne_zero k ha.ne')

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.exists_hiai_factorization
statement:
theorem exists_hiai_factorization
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (ha : 0 < (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn)) :
    ∃ X Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜,
      S = Y * X ∧
      (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) ≤ X.conjTranspose * X ∧
      Y.conjTranspose * Y ≤ Matrix.scalar (Fin n)
        (RCLike.ofReal
          ((Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn) ^ 2)) ∧
      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn) ^ k *
          (Matrix.toEuclideanLin X).normDet =
        ∏ j : Fin k, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues j
proof:
:= by
  let G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := S.conjTranspose * S
  let hG : G.IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self S
  let U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := decreasingEigenvectorUnitary hG
  let d : Fin n → ℝ := hiaiScale S hk hkn
  let D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 :=
    Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ d)
  let E : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 :=
    Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal (d i)⁻¹)
  let L : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 :=
    Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ decreasingEigenvalues hG)
  let X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := U * D * U.conjTranspose
  let Xinv : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := U * E * U.conjTranspose
  let Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := S * Xinv
  have hU : U.conjTranspose * U = 1 :=
    decreasingEigenvectorUnitary_isometry hG
  have hUU : U * U.conjTranspose = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hU
  have hdpos : ∀ i, 0 < d i := hiaiScale_pos S hk hkn ha
  have hdnonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i := fun i ↦ (hdpos i).le
  have hdone : ∀ i, 1 ≤ d i := hiaiScale_one_le S hk hkn ha
  have hdanti : Antitone d := hiaiScale_antitone S hk hkn ha
  have hDstar : D.conjTranspose = D := by
    change (Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ d)).conjTranspose =
      Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ d)
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose]
    congr 1
    funext i
    simp
  have hEstar : E.conjTranspose = E := by
    change (Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal (d i)⁻¹)).conjTranspose =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal (d i)⁻¹)
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose]
    congr 1
    funext i
    simp
  have hDE : D * E = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, ← Matrix.diagonal_one]
    congr 1
    funext i
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, RCLike.ofReal_inv]
    exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (RCLike.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hdpos i).ne')
  have hED : E * D = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hDE
  have hXstar : X.conjTranspose = X := by
    simp [X, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hDstar, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hXinvstar : Xinv.conjTranspose = Xinv := by
    simp [Xinv, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hEstar, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hXinvX : Xinv * X = 1 := by
    calc
      Xinv * X = U * E * (U.conjTranspose * U) * D * U.conjTranspose := by
        simp only [Xinv, X]
        noncomm_ring
      _ = U * (E * D) * U.conjTranspose := by rw [hU]; noncomm_ring
      _ = U * U.conjTranspose := by rw [hED]; simp
      _ = 1 := hUU
  have hfactor : S = Y * X := by
    have hprod : (S * Xinv) * X = S := by
      calc
        (S * Xinv) * X = S * (Xinv * X) := Matrix.mul_assoc S Xinv X
        _ = S * 1 := congrArg (fun M ↦ S * M) hXinvX
        _ = S := Matrix.mul_one S
    calc
      S = (S * Xinv) * X := hprod.symm
      _ = Y * X := by rfl
  have hDD : D * D =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal (d i ^ 2)) := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext i
    simp [pow_two]
  have hdiagExpand : (D * D - 1).PosSemidef := by
    rw [hDD, ← Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.diagonal_sub]
    apply Matrix.PosSemidef.diagonal
    intro i
    have hi : 0 ≤ d i ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith [hdone i]
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply]
    rw [← RCLike.ofReal_one]
    rw [← RCLike.ofReal_sub]
    exact RCLike.ofReal_nonneg.mpr hi
  have hXX : X * X = U * (D * D) * U.conjTranspose := by
    simp only [X]
    calc
      (U * D * U.conjTranspose) * (U * D * U.conjTranspose) =
          U * D * (U.conjTranspose * U) * D * U.conjTranspose := by
        noncomm_ring
      _ = U * (D * D) * U.conjTranspose := by rw [hU]; noncomm_ring
  have hdiffExpand : X.conjTranspose * X - 1 =
      U * (D * D - 1) * U.conjTranspose := by
    rw [hXstar, hXX]
    calc
      U * (D * D) * U.conjTranspose - 1 =
          U * (D * D) * U.conjTranspose - U * U.conjTranspose := by rw [hUU]
      _ = U * (D * D - 1) * U.conjTranspose := by noncomm_ring
  have hExpandPSD : (X.conjTranspose * X - 1).PosSemidef := by
    rw [hdiffExpand]
    simpa using hdiagExpand.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same U.conjTranspose
  have hExpand : (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) ≤
      X.conjTranspose * X := Matrix.le_iff.mpr hExpandPSD
  have hGrel : G * U = U * L :=
    mul_decreasingEigenvectorUnitary hG
  have hGdiag : U.conjTranspose * G * U = L := by
    calc
      U.conjTranspose * G * U = U.conjTranspose * (G * U) := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = U.conjTranspose * (U * L) := by rw [hGrel]
      _ = (U.conjTranspose * U) * L := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = L := by rw [hU, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hELE : E * L * E = Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦
      RCLike.ofReal (decreasingEigenvalues hG i / d i ^ 2)) := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext i
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, ← RCLike.ofReal_mul,
      RCLike.ofReal_inj]
    have hdi : d i ≠ 0 := (hdpos i).ne'
    field_simp [hdi]
  let a := (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn)
  have hdiagBound :
      (Matrix.scalar (Fin n) (RCLike.ofReal (a ^ 2)) - E * L * E).PosSemidef := by
    rw [Matrix.scalar_apply, hELE, Matrix.diagonal_sub]
    apply Matrix.PosSemidef.diagonal
    intro i
    have hi : 0 ≤ a ^ 2 - decreasingEigenvalues hG i / d i ^ 2 :=
      sub_nonneg.mpr (gramEigenvalue_div_hiaiScale_sq_le S hk hkn ha i)
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply]
    rw [← RCLike.ofReal_sub]
    exact RCLike.ofReal_nonneg.mpr hi
  have hYgram : Y.conjTranspose * Y = U * (E * L * E) * U.conjTranspose := by
    rw [show Y.conjTranspose * Y = Xinv * G * Xinv by
      simp [Y, G, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hXinvstar, Matrix.mul_assoc]]
    simp only [Xinv]
    calc
      (U * E * U.conjTranspose) * G * (U * E * U.conjTranspose) =
          U * E * (U.conjTranspose * G * U) * E * U.conjTranspose := by
        noncomm_ring
      _ = U * (E * L * E) * U.conjTranspose := by rw [hGdiag]; noncomm_ring
  have hdiffBound :
      Matrix.scalar (Fin n) (RCLike.ofReal (a ^ 2)) - Y.conjTranspose * Y =
        U * (Matrix.scalar (Fin n) (RCLike.ofReal (a ^ 2)) - E * L * E) *
          U.conjTranspose := by
    rw [hYgram]
    have hscalarConj :
        U * Matrix.scalar (Fin n) (RCLike.ofReal (a ^ 2)) * U.conjTranspose =
          Matrix.scalar (Fin n) (RCLike.ofReal (a ^ 2)) := by
      rw [← Matrix.scalar_comm (RCLike.ofReal (a ^ 2))
        (fun r' ↦ Commute.all _ r') U, Matrix.mul_assoc, hUU, Matrix.mul_one]
    calc
      Matrix.scalar (Fin n) (RCLike.ofReal (a ^ 2)) -
          U * (E * L * E) * U.conjTranspose =
          U * Matrix.scalar (Fin n) (RCLike.ofReal (a ^ 2)) * U.conjTranspose -
            U * (E * L * E) * U.conjTranspose := by
        rw [hscalarConj]
      _ = U * (Matrix.scalar (Fin n) (RCLike.ofReal (a ^ 2)) - E * L * E) *
          U.conjTranspose := by noncomm_ring
  have hBoundPSD :
      (Matrix.scalar (Fin n) (RCLike.ofReal (a ^ 2)) -
        Y.conjTranspose * Y).PosSemidef := by
    rw [hdiffBound]
    simpa using hdiagBound.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same U.conjTranspose
  have hBound : Y.conjTranspose * Y ≤
      Matrix.scalar (Fin n) (RCLike.ofReal (a ^ 2)) :=
    Matrix.le_iff.mpr hBoundPSD
  have hXU : X * U = U * D := by
    simp only [X]
    calc
      U * D * U.conjTranspose * U = U * D * (U.conjTranspose * U) := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = U * D := by rw [hU, Matrix.mul_one]
  let GX : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := X.conjTranspose * X
  let hGX : GX.IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self X
  have hGXeq : GX = U * (D * D) * U.conjTranspose := by
    calc
      GX = X.conjTranspose * X := by rfl
      _ = X * X := by rw [hXstar]
      _ = U * (D * D) * U.conjTranspose := hXX
  have hGXrel : GX * U = U *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal (d i ^ 2)) := by
    rw [hGXeq]
    calc
      U * (D * D) * U.conjTranspose * U =
          U * (D * D) * (U.conjTranspose * U) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = U * (D * D) := by rw [hU, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ RCLike.ofReal (d i ^ 2)) := by rw [hDD]
  have hGXspec : decreasingEigenvalues hGX = fun i ↦ d i ^ 2 :=
    decreasingEigenvalues_eq_of_diagonalization hGX U
      (fun i ↦ d i ^ 2) (hiaiScale_sq_antitone S hk hkn ha) hU hGXrel
  have hsingX : ∀ i : Fin n,
      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin X).singularValues i = d i := by
    intro i
    have hsquare := singularValues_sq_eq_decreasingEigenvalues_gram X i
    change (Matrix.toEuclideanLin X).singularValues i ^ 2 =
      decreasingEigenvalues hGX i at hsquare
    rw [hGXspec] at hsquare
    exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (LinearMap.singularValues_nonneg _ _) (hdnonneg i)).mp hsquare
  have hnormX : (Matrix.toEuclideanLin X).normDet = ∏ i : Fin n, d i := by
    rw [← prod_singularValues_eq_normDet]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ hsingX i)
  have hvolume : a ^ k * (Matrix.toEuclideanLin X).normDet =
      ∏ j : Fin k, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues j := by
    rw [hnormX]
    exact hiaiScale_volume_identity S hk hkn ha
  exact ⟨X, Y, hfactor, hExpand, by simpa [a] using hBound,
    by simpa [a] using hvolume⟩

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.selectedSingularProduct_of_injective
statement:
theorem selectedSingularProduct_of_injective
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (S T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (hS : Function.Injective (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S))
    (hT : Function.Injective (Matrix.toEuclideanLin T))
    (indices : Fin k ↪ Fin n) :
    (∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (S * T)).singularValues (indices j)) ≤
      (∏ j : Fin k, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues j) *
        ∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin T).singularValues (indices j)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 0 <
      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn) := by
    have hall :=
      (LinearMap.injective_iff_forall_lt_finrank_singularValues_pos
        (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S)).mp hS
    apply hall
    simp
  obtain ⟨X, Y, hfactor, hX, hY, hvolume⟩ :=
    exists_hiai_factorization S hk hkn ha
  exact selected_product_of_factorization S T X Y
    ((Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues (kthIndex hk hkn)) ha.le
    hfactor hY hX hvolume hT indices

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.toEuclideanLin_injective_of_posDef
statement:
theorem toEuclideanLin_injective_of_posDef
    {n : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    Function.Injective (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply WithLp.ofLp_injective 2
  apply Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hA.isUnit
  have h := congrArg WithLp.ofLp hxy
  simpa [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply] using h

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.selectedGramProduct_of_injective
statement:
theorem selectedGramProduct_of_injective
    {n k : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (S T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (hS : Function.Injective (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S))
    (hT : Function.Injective (Matrix.toEuclideanLin T))
    (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk : k < n) :
    prefixProd (fun i ↦ decreasingEigenvalues
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (S * T)) (p i))
        k hk.le ≤
      prefixProd (decreasingEigenvalues
        (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self S)) k hk.le *
      prefixProd (fun i ↦ decreasingEigenvalues
        (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self T) (p i)) k hk.le
proof:
:= by
  let indices : Fin k ↪ Fin n :=
    ⟨fun j ↦ p (Fin.castLE hk.le j), by
      intro a b hab
      apply Fin.ext
      have hpEq : p (Fin.castLE hk.le a) = p (Fin.castLE hk.le b) := hab
      exact congrArg (fun z : Fin n ↦ z.val) (p.injective hpEq)⟩
  have h := selectedSingularProduct_of_injective
    S T hk0 hk.le hS hT indices
  let lhs : ℝ := ∏ j,
    (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (S * T)).singularValues (indices j)
  let rhs : ℝ :=
    (∏ j : Fin k, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues j) *
      ∏ j, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin T).singularValues (indices j)
  have hlhs : 0 ≤ lhs := Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ ↦
    LinearMap.singularValues_nonneg _ _
  have hsquare : lhs * lhs ≤ rhs * rhs :=
    mul_self_le_mul_self hlhs (by simpa [lhs, rhs] using h)
  unfold prefixProd
  simp_rw [← singularValues_sq_eq_decreasingEigenvalues_gram]
  change
    (∏ j : Fin k,
      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (S * T)).singularValues (indices j) ^ 2) ≤
      (∏ j : Fin k, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S).singularValues j ^ 2) *
        ∏ j : Fin k, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin T).singularValues (indices j) ^ 2
  rw [Finset.prod_pow, Finset.prod_pow, Finset.prod_pow]
  dsimp [lhs, rhs] at hsquare
  nlinarith

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.lidskiiSelectedProducts_from_gelfandNaimark
statement:
theorem lidskiiSelectedProducts_from_gelfandNaimark
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] : LidskiiSelectedProducts 𝕜
proof:
:= by
  intro n _ B Y hB hY p k hk0 hk
  let R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := B ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := Y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := Y ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  let S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 := R * Z
  have hRpos : R.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hB _
  have hQpos : Q.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hY _
  have hZpos : Z.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hY _
  have hRinj := toEuclideanLin_injective_of_posDef hRpos
  have hQinj := toEuclideanLin_injective_of_posDef hQpos
  have hZinj := toEuclideanLin_injective_of_posDef hZpos
  have hSinj : Function.Injective (Matrix.toEuclideanLin S) := by
    rw [show Matrix.toEuclideanLin S =
        (Matrix.toEuclideanLin R).comp (Matrix.toEuclideanLin Z) by
      exact toEuclideanLin_mul R Z]
    exact hRinj.comp hZinj
  have hRstar : R.conjTranspose = R := hRpos.isHermitian.eq
  have hQstar : Q.conjTranspose = Q := hQpos.isHermitian.eq
  have hZstar : Z.conjTranspose = Z := hZpos.isHermitian.eq
  have hRR : R * R = B := by
    simpa [R] using Matrix.PosDef.half_mul_half hB
  have hQQ : Q * Q = Y := by
    simpa [Q] using Matrix.PosDef.half_mul_half hY
  have hZQ : Z * Q = 1 := by
    simpa [Z, Q] using Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_mul_half hY
  have hST : S * Q = R := by
    simp only [S]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hZQ, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hSTgram : (S * Q).conjTranspose * (S * Q) = B := by
    rw [hST, hRstar, hRR]
  have hSgram : S.conjTranspose * S = relativeMatrix Y B := by
    simp only [S, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hRstar, hZstar]
    calc
      (Z * R) * (R * Z) = Z * (R * R) * Z := by noncomm_ring
      _ = Z * B * Z := by rw [hRR]
      _ = relativeMatrix Y B := rfl
  have hQgram : Q.conjTranspose * Q = Y := by rw [hQstar, hQQ]
  have h := selectedGramProduct_of_injective S Q hSinj hQinj p hk0 hk
  have hSTeigs := decreasingEigenvalues_congr
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (S * Q)) hB.isHermitian hSTgram
  have hSeigs := decreasingEigenvalues_congr
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self S)
    (relativeMatrix_posDef hY hB).isHermitian hSgram
  have hQeigs := decreasingEigenvalues_congr
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self Q) hY.isHermitian hQgram
  rw [hSTeigs, hSeigs, hQeigs] at h
  have hprodY : 0 < prefixProd
      (fun i ↦ decreasingEigenvalues hY.isHermitian (p i)) k hk.le :=
    prefixProd_pos
      (fun i ↦ Matrix.PosDef.decreasingEigenvalues_pos hY _) k hk.le
  rw [prefixProd, prefixProd, Finset.prod_div_distrib]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hprodY).2
  simpa [prefixProd, mul_comm] using h

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.lidskii_from_gelfandNaimark
statement:
theorem lidskii_from_gelfandNaimark
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] : Lidskii 𝕜
proof:
:=
  lidskii_of_properPrefix
    (lidskiiProperPrefix_of_ratioProducts
      (ratioProducts_of_selectedProducts
        lidskiiSelectedProducts_from_gelfandNaimark))

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.matrix_nnrpow_integral_representation
statement:
theorem matrix_nnrpow_integral_representation
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {p : ℝ≥0} (hp : p ∈ Ioo 0 1)
    {mu : Measure ℝ}
    (hmu : ∀ x ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ),
      IntegrableOn (fun s ↦ Real.rpowIntegrand₀₁ p s x) (Ioi 0) mu ∧
        x ^ (p : ℝ) =
          ∫ s in Ioi 0, Real.rpowIntegrand₀₁ p s x ∂mu)
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    IntegrableOn
        (fun s ↦ cfcₙ (Real.rpowIntegrand₀₁ p s) A) (Ioi 0) mu ∧
      A ^ p =
        ∫ s in Ioi 0, cfcₙ (Real.rpowIntegrand₀₁ p s) A ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  have p_pos : 0 < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp.1
  let f s := Real.rpowIntegrand₀₁ p s
  let maxr := sSup (quasispectrum ℝ A)
  have maxr_nonneg : 0 ≤ maxr :=
    le_csSup_of_le (b := 0) (IsCompact.bddAbove (by grind)) (by simp) (by simp)
  let bound (s : ℝ) := ‖f s maxr‖
  have hf : ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry f)
      (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ quasispectrum ℝ A) := by
    refine Real.continuousOn_rpowIntegrand₀₁_uncurry hp (quasispectrum ℝ A) ?_
    grind
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ s ∂mu.restrict (Ioi 0),
      ∀ z ∈ quasispectrum ℝ A, ‖f s z‖ ≤ bound s := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with s hs
    intro z hz
    have hz' : 0 ≤ z := by grind
    unfold bound f
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg
          (Real.rpowIntegrand₀₁_nonneg p_pos (le_of_lt hs) hz'),
      Real.norm_of_nonneg
          (Real.rpowIntegrand₀₁_nonneg p_pos (le_of_lt hs) maxr_nonneg)]
    refine Real.rpowIntegrand₀₁_monotoneOn hp (le_of_lt hs)
      hz' maxr_nonneg ?_
    exact le_csSup (IsCompact.bddAbove (quasispectrum.isCompact _)) hz
  have hbound_finite_integral :
      HasFiniteIntegral bound (mu.restrict (Ioi 0)) := by
    rw [hasFiniteIntegral_norm_iff]
    exact (hmu maxr maxr_nonneg).1.2
  have hmapzero : ∀ᵐ (x : ℝ) ∂mu.restrict (Ioi 0),
      Real.rpowIntegrand₀₁ p x 0 = 0 := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi]
    simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact integrableOn_cfcₙ measurableSet_Ioi _ bound A hf hmapzero
      hbound hbound_finite_integral
  · calc
      A ^ p = cfcₙ
          (fun r ↦ ∫ s in Ioi 0, Real.rpowIntegrand₀₁ p s r ∂mu) A := by
        rw [CFC.nnrpow_eq_cfcₙ_real _ _]
        exact cfcₙ_congr fun r _ ↦ (hmu r (by grind)).2
      _ = ∫ s in Ioi 0, cfcₙ (Real.rpowIntegrand₀₁ p s) A ∂mu :=
        cfcₙ_setIntegral measurableSet_Ioi _ bound A hf hmapzero hbound
          hbound_finite_integral hA.isSelfAdjoint

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.cfcₙ_rpowIntegrand₀₁_eq
statement:
theorem cfcₙ_rpowIntegrand₀₁_eq
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {p s : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Ioo 0 1) (hs : 0 < s)
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    cfcₙ (Real.rpowIntegrand₀₁ p s) A =
      algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) (s ^ (p - 1)) -
        s ^ p • Ring.inverse (algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) s + A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cfcₙ_eq_cfc
    (hf := (Real.continuousOn_rpowIntegrand₀₁_Ici hp hs).mono (by grind))
    (hf0 := by simp)]
  rw [Real.rpowIntegrand₀₁_eq_sub hp.2.ne hs]
  have hg : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ ↦ (s + z)⁻¹) (spectrum ℝ A) := by
    fun_prop (disch := grind -abstractProof)
  have hspectrum : ∀ r ∈ spectrum ℝ A, s + r ≠ 0 := by grind
  have hsub := cfc_sub
    (fun _ : ℝ ↦ s ^ (p - 1)) (fun z : ℝ ↦ s ^ p * (s + z)⁻¹) A
  rw [hsub,
    cfc_const _ A hA.isSelfAdjoint,
    cfc_const_mul _ _ A hg,
    cfc_inv _ A hspectrum (hf := by fun_prop) (ha := hA.isSelfAdjoint),
    cfc_const_add s (fun z : ℝ ↦ z) A (by fun_prop) hA.isSelfAdjoint,
    cfc_id' ℝ A hA.isSelfAdjoint]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.compress_algebraMap
statement:
theorem compress_algebraMap
    {n k : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k]
    {V : Matrix n k ℂ} (hV : MatrixIsometry V) (s : ℝ) :
    compress V (algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) s) =
      algebraMap ℝ (Matrix k k ℂ) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  simp only [compress, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [hV]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.compress_sub
statement:

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.compress_cfcₙ_rpowIntegrand₀₁_le
statement:
theorem compress_cfcₙ_rpowIntegrand₀₁_le
    {n k : Type*} [Fintype n]
    [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k]
    {p s : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Ioo 0 1) (hs : 0 < s)
    {V : Matrix n k ℂ} (hV : MatrixIsometry V)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    compress V (cfcₙ (Real.rpowIntegrand₀₁ p s) A) ≤
      cfcₙ (Real.rpowIntegrand₀₁ p s) (compress V A)
proof:
:= by
  let Y : Matrix n n ℂ := algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) s + A
  have hscalar :
      (algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) s).PosDef := by
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    exact Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hs
  have hY : Y.PosDef := hscalar.add hA
  have hcompY : compress V Y =
      algebraMap ℝ (Matrix k k ℂ) s + compress V A := by
    simp only [Y, compress, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
    rw [show V.conjTranspose * algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) s * V =
        algebraMap ℝ (Matrix k k ℂ) s from compress_algebraMap hV s]
  have hinv : (compress V Y)⁻¹ ≤ compress V Y⁻¹ :=
    inverse_compress_le hV hY
  letI : Invertible Y := hY.isUnit.invertible
  letI : Invertible (compress V Y) :=
    (compress_posDef hV hY).isUnit.invertible
  have hinvRing : Ring.inverse (compress V Y) ≤
      compress V (Ring.inverse Y) := by
    rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse] at hinv
    exact hinv
  rw [cfcₙ_rpowIntegrand₀₁_eq hp hs A hA.posSemidef.nonneg]
  rw [cfcₙ_rpowIntegrand₀₁_eq hp hs (compress V A)
    (compress_posDef hV hA).posSemidef.nonneg]
  calc
    compress V
        (algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) (s ^ (p - 1)) -
          s ^ p • Ring.inverse Y) =
        algebraMap ℝ (Matrix k k ℂ) (s ^ (p - 1)) -
          s ^ p • compress V (Ring.inverse Y) := by
      rw [compress_sub, compress_algebraMap hV,
        compress_smul_real]
    _ ≤ algebraMap ℝ (Matrix k k ℂ) (s ^ (p - 1)) -
          s ^ p • Ring.inverse (compress V Y) := by
      gcongr
    _ = algebraMap ℝ (Matrix k k ℂ) (s ^ (p - 1)) -
          s ^ p • Ring.inverse
            (algebraMap ℝ (Matrix k k ℂ) s + compress V A) := by
      rw [hcompY]

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.compress_rpow_le
statement:
theorem compress_rpow_le
    {V : Matrix n k ℂ} (hV : MatrixIsometry V)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef)
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    compress V (A ^ t) ≤ (compress V A) ^ t
proof:
:= by
  rcases ht0.eq_or_lt with rfl | ht0
  · rw [CFC.rpow_zero A hA.posSemidef.nonneg,
      CFC.rpow_zero (compress V A)
        (compress_posDef hV hA).posSemidef.nonneg]
    simpa [compress] using le_of_eq hV
  rcases ht1.eq_or_lt with rfl | ht1
  · simp [CFC.rpow_one A hA.posSemidef.nonneg,
      CFC.rpow_one (compress V A) (compress_posDef hV hA).posSemidef.nonneg]
  let p : ℝ≥0 := ⟨t, ht0.le⟩
  have hp : p ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ≥0) 1 := by
    constructor
    · exact_mod_cast ht0
    · exact_mod_cast ht1
  have hpReal : (p : ℝ) ∈ Ioo 0 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast hp
  obtain ⟨mu, hmu⟩ :=
    Real.exists_measure_rpow_eq_integral_rpowIntegrand₀₁ hpReal
  have hrepA := matrix_nnrpow_integral_representation hp hmu A
    hA.posSemidef.nonneg
  have hrepC := matrix_nnrpow_integral_representation hp hmu (compress V A)
    (compress_posDef hV hA).posSemidef.nonneg
  change compress V (A ^ (p : ℝ)) ≤ (compress V A) ^ (p : ℝ)
  rw [← CFC.nnrpow_eq_rpow hp.1, ← CFC.nnrpow_eq_rpow hp.1]
  rw [hrepA.2, hrepC.2, compress_setIntegral V hrepA.1]
  apply integral_mono_ae ((compressCLM V).integrable_comp hrepA.1) hrepC.1
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with s hs
  exact compress_cfcₙ_rpowIntegrand₀₁_le hpReal hs hV hA

theorem Matrix.PosDef.sqrt_mul_sqrt
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) = A
proof:
:= by
  have h := CFC.rpow_add (a := A) (x := (1 / 2 : ℝ))

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.weightedGeometricMean_compress_le
statement:
theorem weightedGeometricMean_compress_le
    {n k : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k]
    {V : Matrix n k ℂ} (hV : MatrixIsometry V)
    {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef)
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    compress V (weightedGeometricMean A B t) ≤
      weightedGeometricMean (compress V A) (compress V B) t
proof:
:= by
  let C : Matrix k k ℂ := compress V A
  let R : Matrix n n ℂ := A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let Q : Matrix n n ℂ := A ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  let T : Matrix k k ℂ := C ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let S : Matrix k k ℂ := C ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  let X : Matrix n n ℂ := Q * B * Q
  let W : Matrix n k ℂ := R * V * S
  have hC : C.PosDef := compress_posDef hV hA
  have hR : R.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hA _
  have hQ : Q.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hA _
  have hT : T.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hC _
  have hS : S.PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.rpow hC _
  have hX : X.PosDef := by
    have hQstar : Q.conjTranspose = Q := hQ.isHermitian.eq
    simpa only [X, hQstar] using hB.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
      (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hQ.isUnit)
  have hRR : R * R = A := by
    simpa only [R] using Matrix.PosDef.sqrt_mul_sqrt hA
  have hW : MatrixIsometry W := by
    change W.conjTranspose * W = 1
    rw [show W.conjTranspose = S * V.conjTranspose * R by
      simp only [W, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hR.isHermitian.eq,
        hS.isHermitian.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc]]
    calc
      (S * V.conjTranspose * R) * W =
          S * (V.conjTranspose * ((R * R) * V)) * S := by
        simp only [W, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = S * (V.conjTranspose * (A * V)) * S := by rw [hRR]
      _ = S * C * S := by simp only [C, compress, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_conjugate_self hC
  have hRXR : R * X * R = B := by
    calc
      R * X * R = (R * Q) * B * (Q * R) := by
        simp only [X]
        noncomm_ring
      _ = B := by
        rw [show R * Q = 1 from Matrix.PosDef.half_mul_invHalf hA,
          show Q * R = 1 from Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_mul_half hA,
          Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hcompressWX : compress W X = S * compress V B * S := by
    calc
      compress W X =
          S * (V.conjTranspose * ((R * X * R) * V)) * S := by
        simp only [compress, W, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
          hR.isHermitian.eq, hS.isHermitian.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = S * (V.conjTranspose * (B * V)) * S := by rw [hRXR]
      _ = S * compress V B * S := by simp only [compress, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hcompressWt : compress W (X ^ t) =
      S * compress V (weightedGeometricMean A B t) * S := by
    calc
      compress W (X ^ t) =
          S * (V.conjTranspose * ((R * X ^ t * R) * V)) * S := by
        simp only [compress, W, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
          hR.isHermitian.eq, hS.isHermitian.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = S * compress V (weightedGeometricMean A B t) * S := by
        simp only [weightedGeometricMean, R, Q, X, compress,
          Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hHansen := compress_rpow_le hW hX ht0 ht1
  rw [hcompressWt, hcompressWX] at hHansen
  have hconj := compress_mono T hHansen
  have hTS : T * S = 1 := Matrix.PosDef.half_mul_invHalf hC
  have hST : S * T = 1 := Matrix.PosDef.invHalf_mul_half hC
  have hcompressT (Z : Matrix k k ℂ) : compress T Z = T * Z * T := by
    rw [compress, hT.isHermitian.eq]
  have hundo (Z : Matrix k k ℂ) : compress T (S * Z * S) = Z := by
    rw [hcompressT]
    calc
      T * (S * Z * S) * T = (T * S) * Z * (S * T) := by
        noncomm_ring
      _ = Z := by rw [hTS, hST, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  calc
    compress V (weightedGeometricMean A B t) =
        compress T (S * compress V (weightedGeometricMean A B t) * S) := by
      exact (hundo _).symm
    _ ≤ compress T ((S * compress V B * S) ^ t) := hconj
    _ = weightedGeometricMean (compress V A) (compress V B) t := by
      rw [hcompressT]
      rfl

name: HiaiLimPowerMeans.ando_from_mathlib
statement:
theorem ando_from_mathlib
    (n k : Type*) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k] [Nonempty k] :
    Ando ℂ n k
proof:
:= by
  intro V A B t hV hA hB ht0 ht1
  exact weightedGeometricMean_compress_le hV hA hB ht0 ht1
